kyoto_toriiebisu_shijo.gf_detail: Ask. Live-tank sashimi, tempura, simmered and grilled fish, Kyoto oden and obanzai; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_toriiebisu_shijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish izakaya; the oden broth is made with katsuobushi and kombu (official site).
kyoto_toriiebisu_shijo.hours_raw: 17:00–23:30 daily including holidays (last order food 22:30, drinks 23:00); open year-round apart from the New Year break (Tabelog). Bookings online or by phone (official site). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 90 seats: counter, sunken seats, a private room with a courtyard on the 1st floor, and tank-view and semi-private seats on the 2nd floor (Tabelog; official site). Non-smoking, with a smoking room by the restrooms (Tabelog; September 2026 review). Children welcome (Tabelog). On Shinmachi south of Shijo, 3 minutes from Karasuma station exit 26 (Tabelog). Opened 29 October 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_toriiebisu_shijo.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo-Karasuma, live tank and sake] A large fish izakaya with a live tank, courtyard private room and semi-private booths: ikizukuri from the tank, Kyoto oden, obanzai and about 60 sakes. All-you-can-drink courses with sake from ¥6,000 are popular for work dinners. Open daily to 23:30.

roles: Operator: 株式会社照水 (NTA invoice register)
chef_bio.background: Opened on 29 October 2024 (Tabelog); the official site marked its second anniversary in October 2026. The invoice registration on Tabelog (T4130001029162) belongs to 株式会社照水 of Shimogyo, Kyoto (NTA invoice register). gurunavi also lists a 魚里ゐ夷 near the Hachijo exit of Kyoto Station; a September 2026 reviewer understood the shop was originally near Kyoto Station, and a July 2026 reviewer had been to “their other branches” several times.
chef_bio.philosophy: Fish kept alive in the tank until it is prepared (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Live-tank ikizukuri; Kyoto oden; sake all-you-can-drink courses.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 company party of eight took a private room for the ¥6,000 all-you-can-drink course and was impressed by the well-known sake names on the list.
Another April 2026 diner on a ¥7,000 course felt the portions small — one piece of obanzai and one piece of fried sea bream each — while praising the fresh sashimi and the private room.
In September 2026 a diner at the popular shop found several dishes out of stock without being told at ordering, and met red konnyaku for the first time.
A September 2026 traveller liked the deep counter with room for the plates but noted smoke from the smoking room in front of the restrooms.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 魚里ゐ夷 (とりいえびす)、京都・四条烏丸、店内の生簀からすくい上げた魚をその場で捌き活け造りや焼き物に、天ぷら、煮つけ、京おでん (かつお節と昆布の出汁)、季節のおばんざい、全国の銘酒と限定酒約60種、オリジナル純米酒、3種の飲み比べ、40種以上の日本酒を含む飲み放題付きの海鮮鍋コース6,000円 (税込)、1階に中庭付きの完全個室、2階に生簀を望む席と半個室、京都府京都市下京区新町通四条下ル四条町365-1、075-741-7075、Instagram toriiebisu_kyoto、2026年10月に2周年。食べログ: 魚里ゐ夷、居酒屋・海鮮・おでん、毎日17:00〜23:30 (料理L.O.22:30、ドリンクL.O.23:00)、年中無休、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、90席、個室あり、禁煙 (喫煙ブースあり)、子ども歓迎、オープン日2024年10月29日、適格請求書 T4130001029162。国税庁の適格請求書発行事業者公表サイト: 株式会社照水 (京都市下京区)。ぐるなび: 京都駅八条口近くの魚里ゐ夷 (南区東九条西山王町16)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 飲み放題の日本酒、鯛しゃぶコース7,000円、刺身、おばんざい、鯛の唐揚げ、雑炊 (2026年10月)、量が少ないという声 (2026年4月)、品切れが多い (2026年9月)、喫煙室の煙 (2026年9月)、ほかの店舗にも (2026年7月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Online booking on the official site.

existence.note: Official site (news dated October 2026) and Tabelog; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_tominokoji_raku.gf_detail: GF — ask: no gluten-free claim. Steak is served with salt, garlic chips, wasabi or soy sauce, but the courses also have hashed beef, Caesar salad and soups (2024–26 reviews). The restaurant adjusts courses to requests made in advance (October 2022, June 2024), so ask when booking.
kyoto_tominokoji_raku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses built on wagyu, roast beef, fish and shellfish (2022–26 reviews).
kyoto_tominokoji_raku.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–13:30 and dinner 17:30–21:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations taken (Tabelog); reviewers booked the lunch course ahead (April 2025, January 2026). Cards (AMEX listed); non-smoking; private rooms and private hire; no parking (Tabelog). An L-shaped counter around the griddle on the second floor (December 2023, October 2025) and a private room on the first floor (October 2022; April 2025). Six people filled most of the counter (October 2025).
kyoto_tominokoji_raku.notes: [Teppanyaki · Marutamachi] A teppanyaki restaurant in a renovated machiya with a latticed front, across from the Kyoto Imperial Palace: wagyu fillet cooked at a second-floor counter and served in two rounds to stay hot, fish and Kyoto vegetables from the griddle, hashed beef or garlic rice to finish. Lunch course ¥5,500 (January 2026). Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a teppanyaki restaurant in a renovated traditional machiya (July 2024, January 2026) with kōshi latticework on the front, facing the Kyoto Imperial Palace next to the courthouse (October 2025). The chef cooks in front of the counter guests and tells stories that kept a July 2024 diner laughing; staff ask guests about preferences and timing (December 2023).
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu fillet from the griddle, served in two rounds; requests for favourite ingredients made in advance are worked into the course (June 2024).

anecdotes.text: A December 2022 diner celebrating a friend’s birthday was given a birthday plate and flowers; a March 2025 birthday diner was also given flowers.
An October 2025 party of three couples took almost the whole second-floor counter; at night the palace across the street could not be seen, so the reviewer planned to come back for lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 富小路 RAKU、鉄板焼・肉料理、中京区桝屋町337、丸太町駅から516m、ランチ 12:00〜13:30・ディナー 17:30〜21:00、水曜休み、予約可、カード (AMEX)、個室あり、貸切可、禁煙、駐車場なし。口コミ (2022年6月〜2026年1月、英語): 京都御所の向かい、裁判所の隣、格子の町家を改装、2階のL字カウンターで目の前で焼く、1階に個室、肉は温かいうちに2回に分けて出す、塩・ガーリックチップ・わさび・醤油で、シェフおまかせのランチコース7品5,500円 (2026年1月)、Miyazaki の牛ヒレ、甘鯛のうろこ焼き、締めはガーリックライス・オムライス・ハッシュドビーフなどから選ぶ、誕生日に花のサプライズ。

cultural_comfort.note: Course meal at the counter or in a private room; cards accepted. Tabelog warns that phone service may be in Japanese only. No English evidence found.

kyoto_ikkon_oike.gf_detail: GF — ask: no gluten-free claim. Kushikatsu is battered and fried (Hot Pepper; 2023–24 reviews); obanzai, oden and nikujaga are simmered dishes whose seasonings are not stated.
kyoto_ikkon_oike.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-simmered vegetables (June 2023), nikujaga, oden, yakitori and tsukune. Tabelog’s official information ticks “vegetarian options”; ask what can be made.
kyoto_ikkon_oike.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:00–24:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Hot Pepper gives the same hours with last orders at 23:00 for food and 23:30 for drinks. Reservations taken (Tabelog); a March 2024 same-day booking was not ready on arrival, but a free table was found. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB) and QR (PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay); no e-money (Tabelog). 25 seats: counter 8, three tables for 4, one private room for 6–8 (Tabelog; Hot Pepper gives 24 seats with a 6-seat counter); private hire for 20–50; smoking in the private room on request (Tabelog). English and Chinese menus with photos; children welcome, kids’ menu, strollers OK; wheelchair access (Tabelog official information). 1F of Royal Plaza, 2 minutes from Nijojo-mae Station. Opened 9 March 2003 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ikkon_oike.notes: [Izakaya · Oike] A cosy, couple-run izakaya by Nijojo-mae Station, open until midnight: seasonal obanzai, oden, kushikatsu, yakitori and a nikujaga the shop calls the world’s best. English menu; private room; children welcome. The shop says the owner’s fortune-telling is popular too. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened on 9 March 2003 (Tabelog). Run by a husband-and-wife couple (November and December 2023 reviews); a Hot Pepper reviewer describes a quiet, craftsmanlike husband cooking and a talkative okami explaining the dishes. A November 2024 reviewer praised the beautiful owner’s kind, attentive service. The shop’s own Tabelog text says the owner’s fortune-telling is popular, and that local obanzai can be ordered for shipping.
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai, oden and nikujaga.

anecdotes.text: A November 2023 diner thanked the chef and the okami for staying open late, to a soundtrack of 1980s pop.
A November 2023 reviewer said it felt like a grandmother’s home cooking, and noted the private room makes it easy with children.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (公式情報): いっこん、和食・居酒屋、中京区御池小川西入ル ロイヤルプラザ御池 1F、二条城前駅から徒歩2分、火〜日 17:00〜24:00、月曜休み、予約可、25席 (カウンター8、テーブル4名×3、個室6〜8名×1)、貸切20〜50名、個室は希望で喫煙可、カード・QR可、電子マネー不可、英語・中国語メニュー、写真付きメニュー、子供可・お子様メニュー、車椅子可、日本酒・焼酎にこだわり、ベジタリアンメニューあり、オーナーの占いも人気、おばんざいの発送も受け付け、2003年3月9日オープン。ホットペッパー: いっこん 京都烏丸御池、御池通下古城町398ロイヤルプラザ1F、料理L.O. 23:00・ドリンクL.O. 23:30、24席、世界一の肉じゃが1,078円、おばんざい盛り合わせ1,430円、里芋の唐揚858円、串カツ1本275円〜、焼き鳥2本418円〜、事前予約のオリジナル手毬寿司1,980円、コース4,500円、寡黙な職人肌のご主人と饒舌なおかみさんという口コミ。口コミ (2023年6月〜2026年8月、英語): 夫婦で営む、おでん、肉じゃが、しそ巻き、だし巻き、串カツの油が重かったという声 (2023年11月)、当日予約の席が用意されていなかった (2024年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English and Chinese menus with photos (Tabelog official information; Hot Pepper). No evidence of spoken English.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with official (corporate-member) information; Hot Pepper page live; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_china_tongue.gf_detail: GF — ask: no gluten-free claim. Congee, rice noodles and Hainan chicken rice are on the menu, but sauces and broths are not described, and wonton noodles, dumplings and shumai are wheat (2024–25 sources).
kyoto_china_tongue.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef brisket in beef broth, shrimp wontons, char siu, mapo tofu with minced meat, chicken dishes (2024–25 sources). Stir-fried water spinach appears with squid (July 2025).
kyoto_china_tongue.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon and Wed–Sat 8:00–10:00, 12:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:00; Tue 7:30–11:00, 12:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Sunday. Leaf Kyoto (May 2024) gave lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:30), dinner 17:30–20:30 (last order) and irregular closing days. Reservations taken (Tabelog); a weekday 17:30 booking found the room empty (October 2025). A short queue before noon (May 2025); about 80% full at Saturday noon (April 2025). One person runs the room and kitchen, so order everything at once (October 2025); June and July 2025 reviewers also saw one person working alone, while a May 2025 reviewer saw a staff member besides the owner. Cards; no e-money or QR; non-smoking; private hire (Tabelog). 5 minutes’ walk from Marutamachi Station. Opened 30 August 2023 (Tabelog; Leaf Kyoto).
kyoto_china_tongue.notes: [Hong Kong Chinese · Marutamachi] A small Hong Kong-style all-day restaurant by Marutamachi Station, run by owner-chef Hironori Sano (often single-handed in 2025), formerly executive chef for a Hong Kong restaurant group: scallop congee, wonton and beef brisket noodles, lunch sets with mapo tofu or yodare chicken, a blackboard menu with wine at night. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Leaf Kyoto (May 2024): owner Hironori Sano was executive chef at a hotel in Cambodia, then executive chef for a restaurant group in Hong Kong for five years, and opened CHINA TONGUE on 30 August 2023. June, July and October 2025 reviewers saw one person cooking and serving alone; a May 2025 reviewer saw a staff member as well. A March 2025 reviewer came because of a sister restaurant (named Xiao Xiao in the translated review).
chef_bio.specialty: Hong Kong congee with dried scallops, wonton and beef brisket noodles.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 party of three, alone in the dim evening room, settled seven dishes with the owner by portion size; the owner recommended the oyster fried noodles and XO fried rice as drinking food.

A May 2025 reviewer heard the owner answer loudly and sharply when other diners asked for more time to order, and the water refill never came; April and May 2025 reviewers found the broth very salty, and an October 2025 one found the prices high and the staff intimidating.
A June 2025 diner called the bang bang chicken the best ever, so tender that the reviewer wondered if it was cooked through.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: CHINA TONGUE、中華料理、中京区鏡屋町51-1、地下鉄丸太町駅から徒歩5分、月曜・水曜〜土曜 8:00〜10:00・12:00〜15:00・17:30〜21:00、火曜 7:30〜11:00・12:00〜15:00・17:30〜21:00、日曜休み、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、禁煙、貸切可、2023年8月30日オープン。Leaf Kyoto (2024年5月、英語版): CHINA TONGUE (チャイナ タン)、香港スタイルのオールデイダイニング、オーナーの Hironori Sano はカンボジアのホテルの総料理長、香港のレストラングループで5年総料理長、干し貝柱の香港粥800円、ほたるいかのトッピング600円、点心、蜜汁チャーシュー。口コミ (2025年3月〜11月、英語): 牛バラ肉の米麺1,200円、海老ワンタン麺1,000円、ランチ1,500円の5種、黒板の夜のメニュー、一人で営業、スープの塩気が強いという声、店主の対応への不満の声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the table from a menu and a wall blackboard; cards accepted. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; Leaf Kyoto article (May 2024); reviews dated through November 2025.

kyoto_china_tongue.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260202/26040112/ (35.014998, 135.757902); not cross-checked (worker, no OSM this round); 2026-11-26

kyoto_ryori_wine_ibaraki.gf_detail: GF — ask: no gluten-free claim. Lunch is wheat noodles (Chinese noodles with roasted bran, own site) and dumplings; dinner has carpaccio, confit, grilled lamb and tartare alongside pasta, fried shrimp and fried pike conger (2024–26 reviews). Seasonings are not described.
kyoto_ryori_wine_ibaraki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken, duck and pork in the noodle bowls, bonito flakes on top (2024–26 reviews); meat, fish and pâté at dinner. The tantanmen is made with white miso and soy milk (own site), but its broth and toppings are not stated.
kyoto_ryori_wine_ibaraki.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri lunch 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and dinner 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00); Sat dinner only; closed Sunday. The shop’s site: lunch Monday to Friday only, closed weekends and public holidays, until 20 bowls sell out; dinner last order 22:00, close 23:00; closed Sunday plus irregular days. Reservations taken (Tabelog); few seats, so book (July 2026). 26 seats (Tabelog); the site says the ground floor has two counters with 7 seats in all and two tables for up to 7, and the second floor is for private hire only, 4 to 8 people; Tabelog says a private room needs 4 or more on a course of ¥5,000 or more. Cards and QR; no e-money; non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 16 September 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ryori_wine_ibaraki.notes: [Wine dining · Marutamachi] A machiya on Marutamachi facing the Kyoto Imperial Palace: weekday lunch is Japanese-style Chinese soba in a clear bonito and shiitake broth (white, black or tantanmen, 20 bowls a day); evenings are French and Italian home cooking and yoshoku with wine, in large plates to share. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened on 16 September 2020 (Tabelog). The shop’s site describes French and Italian home cooking and old-style yoshoku with a Kyoto touch, for guests who want to enjoy the ingredients with wine, in a machiya across from the Imperial Palace. A May 2024 reviewer reports the owner-chef saying the aim is not a multicultural menu but deliciousness in every dish. One person was working the lunch service in February 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Simple dishes that let the ingredients speak, with wine (own site).
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch Chinese soba; fried pike conger and fried shrimp with tartar sauce; dishes for wine.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 pair found a painting of a cat village on the wall, ate carpaccio, salads, whelk and Gorgonzola pasta and spent under ¥10,000 for two.
In September 2026 several wines on the list were out of stock, and the staff suggested alternatives in the same price range.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 料理・ワイン イバラキ、京都御所の向かい、丸太町に面する町家、フレンチ・イタリアンの家庭料理や昔ながらの洋食に京都のエッセンス、1階はカウンター計7席とテーブル2つ、2階は貸切限定4〜8名、ランチは月曜〜金曜 (土日・祝日休み) 11:30〜14:00 L.O.・14:30閉店、売り切れ次第終了、3種の中華蕎麦 (鶏の白蕎麦1,000円、鴨ロース黒蕎麦1,100円、白味噌豆乳坦々麺1,100円)、海老水餃子780円、蒸し鶏980円、白ごはん200円、替え玉200円、麺は国産の焙煎フスマ入りの中華麺、ディナー17:30〜22:00 L.O.・23:00閉店、アラカルト500円から、グラスワイン800円〜、ボトルワイン5,500円〜、日曜定休・不定休あり。食べログ: ダイニングバー・日本料理・フレンチ、中京区丸太町通高倉西入坂本町701、26席、個室は4名以上で5,000円以上のコース、2020年9月16日オープン。口コミ (2022年6月〜2026年9月、英語): 白と黒の中華そば、鴨ロース、かつお節としいたけのだし、鱧のフライ、海老フライ1,200円、馬肉のタルタル、パテ・ド・カンパーニュ、Omi の牛肉のハンバーグ、猫の村の絵。

cultural_comfort.note: Order from the menu at counter or table; cards and QR accepted. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Own site (menu and profile pages live); Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_knode_marutamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Open sandwiches on bakery bread and French toast are wheat (2026 reviews); a March 2026 reviewer had a rice-flour banana cake, but its other ingredients were not given.
kyoto_knode_marutamachi.vegan_detail: Limited: a January 2026 reviewer bought a vegan chocolate-chip cookie (¥320) from the baked goods; the breakfasts are egg, bacon and cheese dishes and the cakes are not described as vegan.
kyoto_knode_marutamachi.hours_raw: Daily 9:00–18:00 (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cashless only — cash not accepted (January and November 2026 reviews); Tabelog lists VISA, e-money and QR. No service charge (Tabelog, original text なし). One order per person to eat in (May 2026 review). Few seats: a counter and tables for four (Tabelog; March 2026 review), and a courtyard terrace with a weeping cherry (January 2026 review). Non-smoking; takeaway (Tabelog). At the end of a narrow alley behind a street sign, 393 m from Marutamachi Stn, near the Imperial Palace (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 21 December 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_knode_marutamachi.notes: [Café · Marutamachi] Down a narrow alley near the Imperial Palace, the Kyoto shop of the Kanazawa team behind MORON CAFE: scrambled-egg open sandwiches on Yoshida Bakery bread, French toast and carrot cake, with a small courtyard terrace. About ¥1,000–2,000; cashless only.

chef_bio.background: Opened 21 December 2025 (Tabelog). 2026 reviewers call it the second shop of MORON CAFE, a popular café in Kanazawa, Ishikawa, with the same French toast. The Kanazawa record kz_petra_bake_coffee (PETRA BAKE&COFFEE) calls that shop "the second venture from the team behind the well-loved MORON CAFE in the Nagamachi samurai district", so this may be the team's third shop.
chef_bio.specialty: Scrambled-egg open sandwich; French toast; carrot cake.

anecdotes.text: Arriving early on a February 2026 weekday, a diner found one person preparing everything; the scrambled egg and tomato open sandwich took a while but was excellent, though the onion soup came with a big piece of bread rather than croutons and was a little salty.
A January 2026 visitor, too full for the carrot cake, picked a vegan cookie on a whim and found the chocolate chips made it.
Reviewers in January, October and November 2026 noted many visitors from overseas — about 80% of the customers on one November visit.
An October 2026 visitor sat out on the courtyard terrace, though the air-conditioning unit was noisy there.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Knode (ノード)、カフェ、中京区、丸太町駅から393m、毎日 9:00〜18:00、予約不可、カウンター席、禁煙、テイクアウト、2025年12月21日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 金沢の人気店 MORON CAFE の2号店、細い路地の奥、坪庭のテラス、Yoshida Bakery のパン、スクランブルエッグのオープンサンド1,280円、ベーコンのフレンチトースト1,280円 (2026年5月)、キャロットケーキ620円、カフェラテ650円 (2026年6月)、米粉のバナナケーキ (2026年3月)、ヴィーガンクッキー320円 (2026年1月)、現金不可。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas visitors (2026 reviews); attentive service at busy times (February 2026 review); cashless payment only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_kappo_tb26014175_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai simmered in bonito dashi (September 2010 review) and with soy sauce; tempura (octopus, vegetables, dried squid, tripe) and kushi-katsu have appeared on the menu (2009–2023 reviews).
kyoto_kappo_tb26014175_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: obanzai are simmered in bonito dashi (September 2010 review); sashimi, chicken and beef dishes (2022–26 reviews).
kyoto_kappo_tb26014175_sanjo.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:00–22:00; closed Mondays (Tabelog). Reservations taken; private use possible (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: a counter of 6 and a sunken kotatsu room for 10–14 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). The menu has no prices (October 2026 review); the hot pot may need booking (October 2017 review). Takeaway (September 2022 review). On the ground floor of 春秋ビル on Sanjo-dori just east of Jingumichi, 350 m (5 min) from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; October 2009 review). Reviews from 2009–2011 describe ¥1,000 lunch sets; Tabelog now lists dinner only.
kyoto_kappo_tb26014175_sanjo.notes: [Obanzai · Sanjo-Jingumichi] A small counter on Sanjo near Heian Shrine with a row of obanzai on display and kappo dishes from the kitchen — Kyoto vegetables, grilled nama-fu with yuzu miso, sashimi. A friendly owner runs the room; no prices on the menu, about ¥6,000–10,000; cash only.

chef_bio.background: Reviewed on Tabelog since October 2009, when a ¥1,000 lunch set with five small dishes and coffee drew local regulars (2009–2011 reviews). A 2010 reviewer saw "kushi" (skewers) on the sign. An October 2017 reviewer describes a friendly, handsome chef and a charming woman owner; a September 2022 regular names the friendliness and care of the owner as the best thing about the place.
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai of Kyoto vegetables; kappo dishes; tripe tempura.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 traveller asked about a purple pod on the counter and the owner explained it was a Tanba black-soybean variety grown to eat as edamame.
A family that holds a thank-you dinner here for a work crew left the six-person menu to the owner in September 2022 and, when the men wanted more rice, asked for onigiri — about ¥30,000 for six.
A December 2025 walk-in was welcomed without a booking and planned to come back for the hot pot.
A June 2011 visitor found the staff hurried and the grilled fish of the ¥1,000 set disappointing.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 和洋割烹 竹泉、日本料理、東山区三条通白川橋東入三丁目夷町160-1 春秋ビル 1F、東山駅から徒歩5分、火〜日 17:00〜22:00、月曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、20席 (カウンター6席、掘りごたつ10〜14名)、禁煙。口コミ (英語): カウンターのおばんざい、京野菜 (2025年12月)、生麩の柚子味噌焼き、かつお・鯛・たこのお造り (2026年10月)、メニューに値段なし、明るい女将、2009〜2011年は1,000円の昼定食。

cultural_comfort.note: No prices on the menu; the owner explains the dishes (October 2026 review); phone service may be Japanese only (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated December 2025 and October 2026.

kyoto_takokin_marutamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Oden simmered in dashi (2016–22 reviews) and seasonal kappo dishes including tempura of wild vegetables and shrimp (April 2021) and karasumi mochi; no gluten information.
kyoto_takokin_marutamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in dashi with fish cake, octopus and beef tendon; sashimi and fish dishes (2016–26 reviews).
kyoto_takokin_marutamachi.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:00–22:00; closed Mondays (Tabelog). Reservations taken; private rooms and private use (Tabelog). Cards: VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners; no QR (Tabelog). 37 seats: counter and tatami room (Tabelog). Bring-your-own drinks listed (Tabelog). 281 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn, south of Marutamachi-dori (Tabelog). The website on Tabelog, takokin.jp, did not resolve in November 2026.
kyoto_takokin_marutamachi.notes: [Oden · Marutamachi] A long-running oden kappo with a counter and tatami room: oden in a refined dashi alongside seasonal Kyoto dishes — hamo, guji, karasumi mochi. About ¥15,000–30,000 per person in 2025–26 reviews.

chef_bio.background: A July 2009 reviewer captioned a photo of the noren "大正12年の 歴史あるのれん" (a historic noren from Taisho 12, i.e. 1923). A regular of more than 15 years by 2016 describes a young proprietress joining in (2016 review) and the head chef and a young chef behind the counter (April 2021); an August 2022 diner was glad to see the owner and the proprietress again.
chef_bio.specialty: Oden; seasonal kappo dishes.

anecdotes.text: A regular who comes every spring for the bamboo shoots with kinome miso noted that the karasumi mochi is made differently from the Wakuden style (April 2021).
A February 2024 diner brought a grandmother, who finished every dish of an eclectic meal of sashimi, crab, porridge and oden.
Back after five years in August 2022, a business traveller drank a bottle of Premium Malt's at the counter and finished with a cup of the oden broth.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 多幸金、日本料理・おでん、上京区中町通丸太町下ル駒之町559-20、神宮丸太町駅から281m、火〜日 17:00〜22:00、月曜休み、予約可、カード可、37席、カウンターと座敷、個室あり、ウェブサイト takokin.jp。口コミ (英語): おでん割烹、だしのおでん、季節の料理、からすみ餅 (2021年4月)、大将と若い料理人、若女将、のれんの写真に「大正12年の 歴史あるのれん」(2009年7月の口コミ)、1人15,000〜19,999円 (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter and tatami-room dining; phone service may be Japanese only (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog reviews from visits in April 2025, December 2025 and October 2026; the website takokin.jp did not resolve (November 2026).

kyoto_izakaya_tb26015615_ayanokoji.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi comes with soy-sauce jelly (March 2025) or garlic miso (October 2026); fried dishes include toro katsu, eel and cheese spring rolls, satsuma-age and fried saury (2025 reviews); obanzai in dashi.
kyoto_izakaya_tb26015615_ayanokoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya — sashimi, eel, fish cakes, chicken (2025–26 reviews); vegetables come simmered in dashi (October 2026).
kyoto_izakaya_tb26015615_ayanokoji.hours_raw: Daily 16:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closing days irregular — phone 080-4234-2434 (Tabelog). Banquet menus for groups of 10 or more from 12:30 by booking (Tabelog). Reservations taken and recommended at weekends (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money; no cover charge (Tabelog). 40 seats: a small counter and a 10-seat room on the ground floor, tables for up to 12 and private rooms for up to 30 upstairs; the whole shop can be booked (Tabelog). Smoking allowed at the ground-floor counter; the upstairs tables are non-smoking (Tabelog). Children welcome; BYO drinks listed (Tabelog). The shop says its website and app are no longer updated (Tabelog). On the north corner just east of Ayanokoji-Samegai, 7 min from Shijo or Karasuma Stn, 367 m from Omiya Stn (Tabelog). Operated by Dish&Soul株式会社 (invoice register T3130001054970; Tabelog remarks).
kyoto_izakaya_tb26015615_ayanokoji.notes: [Izakaya · Ayanokoji-Samegai] A two-storey izakaya in an old building near Shijo-Horikawa: sashimi with garlic miso, obanzai, satsuma-age with mozzarella and eel spring rolls, many sakes and lively staff banter. About ¥5,000–8,000; open to 23:00.

chef_bio.background: Run by Dish&Soul株式会社 (registered invoice issuer from 1 October 2023, head office 下京区西綾小路西半町83, NTA register). The Tabelog remarks give a phone number for a second shop, and a March 2026 reviewer describes this as the table-seat shop of 吟味屋 a couple of doors from the "Kaku" shop (the review's English). A March 2025 guest was brought by a friend who has been coming for over 20 years; an April 2025 reviewer guessed from the food why it has lasted so long. Reviewers describe the building as an old house with a traditional exterior (September and November 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi; obanzai; satsuma-age with mozzarella; toro katsu.

anecdotes.text: A family that came in during heavy rain in March 2025 was given fish-bone crackers on the house.
In October 2026 a business traveller found the eggplant in dashi so good as to want ten servings, and enjoyed the staff's Kansai banter and the music.
A March 2026 diner found the all-you-can-drink course of obanzai-style starters, sashimi and chicken soup neither good nor bad, and suggested ordering à la carte at the counter instead.
At a February 2025 banquet the yam with wasabi was a hit but the edamame was oily.
The restaurant was full on a May 2026 visit and the food was slow, but the staff kept the table informed throughout.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 吟味屋 菜々色、居酒屋・海鮮・野菜料理、下京区綾小路醒ケ井東入ル北角、大宮駅から367m、毎日 16:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、不定休、10名以上の宴会は12:30から予約で、40席 (2階のテーブルと個室、1階のカウンター)、1階カウンターは喫煙可、カード・PayPay 可、チャージなし、ホームページとアプリの更新は終了、Dish&Soul株式会社。適格請求書発行事業者: Dish&Soul株式会社 (令和5年10月1日登録)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): お造りとにんにく味噌、しょうゆのジュレ、おばんざい、モッツァレラ入りのさつま揚げ、うなぎとチーズの春巻き、トロカツ、4,000円のコース (2026年1月)、日本酒の飲み放題。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain and recommend dishes, including off-menu ones (2025 reviews); phone service may be Japanese only (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_atarayo_omiya.gf_detail: Ask: small plates include tempura, kara-age, ponzu and soy-based dishes (Tabelog menu, May 2026); no gluten-free option stated.
kyoto_atarayo_omiya.vegan_detail: Ask: there are vegetable small plates such as kinpira burdock, green beans with sesame dressing and chilled celery-tomato (Tabelog menu, May 2026), but no vegan option is stated; ask about dashi and fish in each. The ¥500 otoshi was a miso soup in April 2026.
kyoto_atarayo_omiya.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: Tue–Sun 15:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); closed Monday plus irregular days: check the calendar on the official LINE or Instagram. Reservations through the official LINE account. Otoshi (cover dish) ¥500 per person. Payment: cash only in April 2026 (cards "planned", per a review); in October 2026 reviewers say cards are accepted from ¥3,500; Tabelog lists Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX and PayPay. 10 counter seats; private hire for up to 20. Non-smoking. English menu and menu with photos (Tabelog). Children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). Opened 1 April 2026. 8 min from Hankyu Omiya, 2 min from the Omiya Matsubara city-bus stop; coin parking nearby.
kyoto_atarayo_omiya.notes: [Izakaya · Omiya-Matsubara, a ¥500 sake counter] A ten-seat counter opened in April 2026 by a sake-loving owner who trained at well-known Japanese restaurants in Karasuma: 40–50 sakes and seasonal small plates, almost everything ¥500, chosen to suit your mood. Non-drinkers and families welcome. Opens 15:00; closed Monday. Book via LINE.

chef_bio.background: The official site names the owner (店主) as 藤村 亜弓. A reviewer writes that the owner "has gained experience at several well-known Japanese restaurants in Karasuma" and opened the shop on 1 April 2026 (April 2026). The owner runs the counter alone, so plates can be slow when it is busy (June 2026). Reviewers praise the owner's passion for sake and welcome for non-drinkers (April 2026) and the thoughtful small plates (May 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: the name 可惜夜 (あたらよ) means "a night too wonderful to let it end", and the shop hopes to share such nights with its guests. Tabelog official: "A healing time to enjoy seasonal small dishes and sake."
chef_bio.specialty: Sake chosen by the owner; ¥500 seasonal small plates.

anecdotes.text: April 2026: "Although the restaurant's name includes 'sake and ate,' the owner emphasizes that it would be a shame for those who don't drink to miss out on the food."
October 2026, a regular on the ninth visit: "The offer of a free drink for saying 'Cheers with Japanese sake' is a special arrangement for Japanese Sake Day (October 1st)."
June 2026: "Since the owner is managing everything alone, it can take a while for the appetizers to arrive when it gets busy."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 酒とアテ あたら夜、四条大宮の日本酒居酒屋、店主 藤村 亜弓、下京区北門前町735、15:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:30)、月曜定休と不定休、カウンター10席、お通し500円、予約は公式LINE、営業日はLINEとInstagramで、阪急大宮から徒歩8分、市バス大宮松原から徒歩2分、近くにコインパーキング。日本酒と小皿のアテを500円から、週替わりの日本酒を店主がアテに合わせて選ぶ、一人飲み歓迎。食べログ: 2026年4月1日オープン、カード・PayPay可、貸切は20名まで、禁煙、英語メニュー、子ども可、季節の小皿はすべて500円、日本酒40〜50種。口コミ (2026年4月〜11月、英語): Karasumaの有名な日本料理店で経験を積んだ店主、飲まない人も歓迎、なまこ酢は店主の家のレシピ、ほたるいかの酢味噌、帆立の刺身、お通しは味噌汁 (2026年4月)、一人で切り盛りするので混むと待つ (2026年6月)、2026年4月は現金のみ、10月はカードは3,500円から。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu with photos (Tabelog); the owner recommends sake; book via LINE.

existence.note: Opened 1 April 2026; official site and Tabelog listing with reviews from April to November 2026.

kyoto_oden_shijo_omiya_26015466.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the oden includes kuruma-fu (wheat gluten) and ginger tempura (2022–2025 reviews); yakitori and side dishes too; no gluten-free option stated.
kyoto_oden_shijo_omiya_26015466.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden with beef tendon, octopus, egg and sausage in a broth, plus yakitori (2022–2025 reviews).
kyoto_oden_shijo_omiya_26015466.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 17:00–24:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change. A reviewer (visit of August 2025, with an October follow-up) writes of getting in at 19:30 on a Monday "before they closed at 9 PM", so check the closing time. Tabelog: no reservations; cash only (no cards, e-money or QR). 8 counter seats only. Smoking allowed (Tabelog). No prices on the menu (March 2024; August 2025). Often full of regulars; reviewers found it full at 17:30 on a Saturday (December 2025) and at 18:00 on a Monday (October 2025). The entrance is narrow and low (August 2025). 93 m from Hankyu Omiya, just north of Shijo-Omiya.
kyoto_oden_shijo_omiya_26015466.notes: [Oden · Shijo-Omiya, a Showa-era counter of regulars] A red-lantern oden shop with eight counter seats just north of Shijo-Omiya, run by one person: light Kyoto-style oden broth, yakitori and sake, about ¥2,000–3,000. No prices on the menu, no bookings, cash only, smoking allowed. Often full; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a nostalgic Showa-era counter "always packed with regulars" (March 2023) with "a kind-looking owner" (January 2024), run by the owner alone (August 2025; "run by a single person", December 2025). One reviewer saw a map of the Osaka Expo in Suita on the wall (August 2025). Some ingredients sell out (August and October 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Oden in a light broth; yakitori.

anecdotes.text: August 2025: "The oden had a light color, but the flavor of the broth was well absorbed, making it delicious. Most importantly, it wasn't too salty!"
March 2024: "I was a bit scared because there were no prices listed on the menu, but it turned out to be an amazing restaurant."
December 2025: "I visited around 5:30 PM on a Saturday and found it fully booked. I had a drink at a nearby izakaya, and when I returned, I was lucky to find a spot available."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 盛司、居酒屋、中京区四条大宮上ル、大宮から93m、月・火・木〜日17:00〜24:00、水曜休み、予約不可、現金のみ、カウンター8席、喫煙可。口コミ (2022年6月〜2026年1月、英語): 昭和の雰囲気のおでん屋、常連でいっぱい、やさしそうな店主 (2024年1月)、一人で切り盛り (2025年8月、12月)、薄い色で味のしみたやさしいだし、大根、卵、厚揚げ、牛すじ、たこ、じゃがいも、餅巾着、車麩、しょうがの天ぷら、春菊、ウインナー、しらたき、だし巻きのおでん、焼鳥、一品、Tosa TsuruやKenbishiの日本酒、メニューに値段の記載なし、2,000〜3,000円ほど、入口は狭く低い、21時に閉まったとの記述 (2025年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: A small counter of regulars; no prices on the menu; no bookings; cash only; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated August 2025 to January 2026.

kyoto_yukura_shogoin.gf_detail: Ask: a set monthly course of Japanese dishes with sashimi and dips, dashi-maki egg and other seasoned dishes (2019–2024 reviews); no gluten-free option stated. Ask when you book by phone.
kyoto_yukura_shogoin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an omakase course of Japanese dishes with sashimi and dashi-maki egg (2019–2024 reviews).
kyoto_yukura_shogoin.hours_raw: Official site: from 17:00, closing time not fixed; irregular closing days. Reservation only (Tabelog), by phone (official site); a reviewer booked by phone after 16:00 on the day (February 2026). Cash only (official site). 5 counter seats and 6 table seats; all non-smoking (official site). On the north side of Marutamachi-dori just east of the Higashioji-Marutamachi crossing; 8 min from Keihan Jingu-Marutamachi (official site).
kyoto_yukura_shogoin.notes: [Japanese course · Shogoin by Higashioji-Marutamachi, a couple's small-dish counter] A small townhouse restaurant run by a husband-and-wife team: a monthly omakase course of traditional Japanese small dishes from ¥5,500, beautifully plated, with good sake and an easy chat across the five-seat counter. Book by phone; cash only.

chef_bio.background: The official site, signed by the owner (店主) 板倉 裕一, says the couple run the small shop together (「夫婦二人で営んでいる小さなお店です」) and serve unpretentious small dishes based on traditional Japanese cooking. Reviewers praise "the friendly nature of the owner and the hostess" (September 2020), an owner who shares stories about Kyoto (November 2023), and an unhurried evening of conversation and sake (February 2026). One reviewer found the portions small for men (November 2019).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「奇をてらったものではなく、伝統的な日本料理をベースにした小料理を季節ごとの素材を活かした月替りのコースで、気軽に楽しんでいただきたい」 (not novelty, but small dishes rooted in traditional Japanese cooking, in a monthly course using seasonal ingredients, to be enjoyed casually).
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly omakase course of small dishes.

anecdotes.text: March 2023: "With four counter seats and table seating, it's easy to have enjoyable conversations with the head chef and the proprietress!"
February 2024: "The soy sauce-like dip that accompanied the sashimi was incredibly delicious."
February 2026: "I made a phone reservation just after 4 PM on the day of my visit. Fortunately, it was a quiet day, allowing me to chat with the owner while ordering Junmaishu."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 小料理 裕くら、店主 板倉 裕一、東大路丸太町を東へすぐの北側、夫婦二人で営む小さな店、伝統的な日本料理をベースにした小料理、季節の素材の月替わりのコース、月替わりおまかせコース5,500円から、17時から (閉店時間は不定)、不定休、カウンター5席・テーブル6席、全席禁煙、現金のみ、京阪神宮丸太町から徒歩8分、予約は電話。食べログ: 日本料理、左京区聖護院山王町19-2、予約のみ、カード不可。口コミ (2019年11月〜2026年2月、英語): 店主と女将の人柄、町家の雰囲気、7品のコース4,500円 (2020年、2023年3月)、美しい盛り付けと器、月替わり、日本酒が豊富、刺身のたれ、ほうじ茶のアイス、だし巻きの追加、当日の電話予約 (2026年2月)、男性には量が少なめとの声 (2019年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Phone bookings only; a small counter; cash only.

existence.note: Official site live; Tabelog listing with reviews dated August 2025 and February 2026.

kyoto_totoya_kyoto_honten.gf_detail: Ask: a 2022 reviewer found vegan and gluten-free deli options and a gluten-free chocolate fudge; a rice-flour muffin was sold in March 2026. Deli items are self-served by weight, and wheat items such as scones, croquettes and menchi katsu are sold alongside (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_totoya_kyoto_honten.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: a homemade vegan napa-cabbage and chive kimchi (June 2025), soy-meat nanban (March 2026), a vegan waffle plate (March 2023) and vegan deli items (March 2022); meat, egg and fish dishes are sold too (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_totoya_kyoto_honten.hours_raw: Official site: shop 10:00–19:00; lunch 11:30–14:00; parfait 11:30–17:00; eat-in 11:30–18:00; closed Thursday plus one irregular day a month (announced on Instagram); hours may change, check Instagram. Breakfast events ("breakfasts from around the world") ended as a regular service at the end of July 2026 and are now held irregularly, booked by phone (September 2026). Tabelog: no reservations; cards, e-money and QR codes accepted; non-smoking. A one-drink order with lunch (April 2023). Bring your own containers for bulk goods and takeaway deli, or buy one there (2022–2025). A zero-waste organic supermarket with an eat-in area at the back, facing Kawaramachi-dori north of Marutamachi; 291 m from Keihan Jingu-Marutamachi.
kyoto_totoya_kyoto_honten.notes: [Café · Kawaramachi-Marutamachi, a zero-waste organic supermarket] A package-free organic grocery with an eat-in café at the back: organic curry and salad-bowl lunches, deli sold by weight (including vegan kimchi and soy-meat dishes), sweets and natural wine. Bring a container for takeaway. Lunch about ¥1,200–1,700 (2023–2025 reviews). Closed Thursday.

roles: Staff (unnamed); company: 株式会社斗々屋 (Totoya Inc.)
chef_bio.background: The shop is the Kyoto main shop of 株式会社斗々屋 (Totoya Inc.), founded 2005 and incorporated 2017, which imports, wholesales and retails organic food, wine and bulk-sale equipment and supplies bulk goods to over 100 shops (official site). The company's standards: organic farming, fair trade, zero waste, and no products from intensive livestock farming (official site). Reviewers praise attentive staff who explain the weighing system (June 2022) and friendly staff (September 2024; September 2026). Criticisms: a slow dish and a required drink order making lunch pricey (April 2023), dishes too sour for a child (March 2023), and a reviewer who felt the zero-waste ways were imposed on customers and found the staff poorly coordinated (January 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: the mission is to propose the "things" and "experiences" for 「地球一個分の暮らし」 (living within the means of one Earth).
chef_bio.specialty: Organic deli by weight; curry and salad-bowl lunches; vegan deli items.

anecdotes.text: March 2022: "The prices are listed per 100g, but you can order from as little as 20g. I appreciate that there are vegan and gluten-free deli options available."
June 2025: "Toto Ya's Curry Rice - JPY 1660. This comes with a drink. … It was my first time trying fermented brown rice, and it had a unique texture."
September 2026: "They offer various menus themed around breakfasts from around the world. This time, it was vol.6 featuring a Danish breakfast."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 株式会社斗々屋、2021年7月31日に開いた日本初のゼロ・ウェイストなスーパーマーケット、乾物、液体、野菜、果物、豆腐、納豆、肉、惣菜などを量り売り、京都本店は上京区出水町252 大澤事務所本社ビル1F、10:00〜19:00、ランチ11:30〜14:00、パフェ11:30〜17:00、イートイン11:30〜18:00、木曜定休と月1回の不定休、最新情報はInstagram。会社は2005年創立、2017年設立、オーガニック食材・ワイン・量り売り什器・エコ雑貨の輸入・卸・小売、量り売り商品を全国100以上の店舗へ卸す、有機栽培・公正な取引・ごみゼロ・動物福祉。食べログ: 予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、禁煙。口コミ (2022年3月〜2026年9月、英語): 奥にイートイン、量り売りの惣菜は20gから、ヴィーガンとグルテンフリーの惣菜 (2022年3月)、ヴィーガンのワッフルプレート (2023年3月)、カレーライス1,660円 (2025年6月)、サラダボウルとカレーのランチ (2025年10月)、いなり寿司、メンチカツ、大豆ミートの南蛮、自家製のヴィーガン白菜とニラのキムチ、米粉のマフィン、デンマークの朝ごはん1,800円 (2026年9月)、店員の対応がよいとの声と、押しつけがましい・連携が悪いとの声 (2025年1月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Self-serve deli by weight; staff explain the bulk-buying system (June 2022).

existence.note: Official site lists the Kyoto main shop; Tabelog reviews dated 2025 to September 2026.

kyoto_onigiri_dokoro_sanjo_omiya.gf_detail: Ask. Onigiri of rice and nori; the kara-age is coated in rice flour but seasoned with a garlic soy sauce, and the tenmusu holds shrimp tempura; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_onigiri_dokoro_sanjo_omiya.vegan_detail: Ask. A spicy takana (mustard-leaf) onigiri is on the menu, but nothing is described as vegan; most fillings are fish, meat or egg (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_onigiri_dokoro_sanjo_omiya.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday–Sunday 11:00–17:00; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Eat-in from 13:00 on weekends and public holidays (May 2026). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR payments (Tabelog; June 2026). A counter of 4 or 5 seats (April 2024; February 2025); most customers take away (April 2024; September 2026). No restroom (May and July 2026). The egg-yolk and meat soboro onigiri needs ordering ahead (July 2026). Open since 6 April 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_onigiri_dokoro_sanjo_omiya.notes: [Onigiri · Sanjo shopping street near Omiya, made to order] A tiny onigiri counter on the Sanjo shopping street, open since April 2024 and run by a couple (2025–2026 reviews): fluffy onigiri shaped to order around generous fillings, with a rice-flour kara-age set. Mostly takeaway, a few counter seats; no restroom. Cash only; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe the shop as run by a couple (February 2025; “a lovely couple”, September 2026). Open since April 2024 (Tabelog). The September 2026 reviewer says the onigiri can be made without salt on request.
chef_bio.specialty: Onigiri made to order; rice-flour kara-age.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 diner caught a counter seat just as someone left; a line formed straight after.
A diner who came four times between December 2025 and September 2026 noted that quite a few regulars seem to come for takeaway.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: おにぎり処 成いち、おにぎり、中京区三条通大宮東入ル御供町284-4、二条城前駅から375m、月・水〜日 11:00〜17:00、火曜定休、カード・電子マネー・QR決済不可、2024年4月6日オープン。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 三条の商店街のおにぎり専門店、京都産のNikomaruの米とSetouchiの海苔 (2024年10月)、注文を受けてから握る、ふんわりした米と具だくさん、ピリ辛高菜250円、ツナマヨ290円、焼き鮭310円、焼きたらこ310円、鯖と大葉340円、鮭の柚子胡椒マヨ340円、えびの天ぷらのおにぎり370円、米粉の唐揚げセット490円 (おにぎり2個に唐揚げ・味噌汁・だし巻き・サラダ・漬物)、唐揚げはにんにく醤油の味付け、味噌汁220円、卵黄そぼろは予約が必要 (2026年7月)、塩なしにもできる、カウンター4〜5席、持ち帰りが多い、トイレなし、土日祝日のイートインは13時から、現金のみ、夫婦で営む。

cultural_comfort.note: Small takeaway counter; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing checked 2026-11-26 (no closure badge); reviews dated April 2024 to September 2026.

kyoto_nikusakaya_kamanza_marutamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled wagyu, seared yukhoe, offal teppan-yaki and a beef-tendon curry; no gluten information (Hot Pepper; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nikusakaya_kamanza_marutamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat izakaya; every course dish but the edamame features meat (November 2026).
kyoto_nikusakaya_kamanza_marutamachi.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday–Sunday, incl. public holidays, 17:30–24:00 (food last orders 23:00, drinks 23:30); closed Tuesday (Tabelog; Hot Pepper). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), QUICPay, PayPay, d Barai, au PAY (Tabelog). 50 seats: 10 at the counter, 8 at tables, 12 in private rooms, 20 on tatami (Tabelog); private rooms for 10–20, buyouts for 20–50 — book rooms by phone (Tabelog). Non-smoking, with a smoking area outside (Tabelog). No parking (Tabelog). About 6 minutes from exit 5 of Marutamachi subway station (Hot Pepper). Courses with 120 or 180 minutes of all-you-can-drink, ¥4,500–7,500 tax incl. (Hot Pepper, updated 2026-06-11).
kyoto_nikusakaya_kamanza_marutamachi.notes: [Meat izakaya · Kamanza south of Marutamachi, wagyu and all-you-can-drink] A roomy izakaya near Marutamachi built around meat — charcoal-grilled wagyu steak, seared yukhoe, offal teppan-yaki, beef-tendon curry — plus everyday izakaya plates, with a counter, tatami and private rooms for groups. All-you-can-drink courses from ¥4,500 (Hot Pepper). Late; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a kind owner (October 2021) and a cheerful owner with a lovely smile (March 2026). Tabelog lists the shop as a corporate member; no operator was found.
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu dishes; seared yukhoe.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular orders the avocado salad with mustard dressing and the seared wagyu yukhoe every visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 肉酒屋 輪っか、居酒屋・肉料理、中京区釜座通竹屋町上る桝屋町163 エム'ズ御所西 1F、丸太町駅から徒歩10分 (349m)、月・水〜日・祝日 17:30〜24:00 (料理L.O. 23:00、ドリンクL.O. 23:30)、火曜定休、カード・QUICPay・PayPay・d払い・au PAY可、50席 (カウンター10、テーブル8、個室12、座敷20)、個室は10〜20名、貸切20〜50名、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、駐車場なし。ホットペッパー (2026年6月11日更新): 丸太町にある肉好きが集う大人の隠れ家、梅コース (飲み放題120分付き、ホルモンMIX鉄板焼きなど全8品) 4,500円、竹コース (飲み放題120分付き、炙りユッケ、炭火焼き、特製カレーなど全8品) 5,500円、松コース (飲み放題180分付き、黒毛和牛ステーキなど全8品) 7,500円 (税込)。口コミ (2021〜2026年、英語): 親切な店主、明るく笑顔のすてきな店主、肉料理、黒毛和牛の赤身の炭火焼きステーキ、和牛の炙りとわさび、ハラミの鉄板焼き、和牛のローストビーフ、ポテトサラダ、締めのガーリックライス、炙りユッケ、アボカドのサラダ (マスタードのドレッシング)、カンパチの刺身、メニューにないおでんと刺身、牛すじカレー、飲み放題付きコース5,500円、個室で宴会向き。

cultural_comfort.note: Neighbourhood izakaya; private rooms booked by phone.

existence.note: Tabelog listing checked 2026-11-26 (no closure badge); Hot Pepper course page updated 2026-06-11; reviews dated February 2025 to November 2026.

kyoto_okonomiyaki_shimonocho_shichijo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: okonomiyaki, Manbo-yaki with soba or udon noodles, yakisoba and Okocchobo with tempura scraps — wheat batter and noodles (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_okonomiyaki_shimonocho_shichijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, hoso (offal), aburakasu, egg, chikuwa and bonito flakes (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_okonomiyaki_shimonocho_shichijo.hours_raw: Tuesday and Thursday 11:00–14:00; Friday and Saturday 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–20:30; closed Monday, Wednesday and Sunday (Tabelog, which says hours may change). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR payments (Tabelog; September 2024). Parking in front of the shop (Tabelog). About 20 seats at three teppan tables (December 2025; September 2026), in a former bar with high ceilings and Showa-era posters (September and October 2024). Sauce, mayonnaise, bonito flakes and aonori are self-serve; sweet or spicy sauce (October 2024). About 10 minutes on foot east of Kyoto Station (October 2024; December 2025). Open since 10 February 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_okonomiyaki_shimonocho_shichijo.notes: [Okonomiyaki · east of Kyoto Station, Manbo-yaki] A homely okonomiyaki lunch spot a 10-minute walk east of Kyoto Station, in a former bar with high ceilings and Showa posters, run by two women: huge Manbo-yaki crisping on the teppan, hoso yakisoba, and Okocchobo, a Kyoto-style okonomiyaki. Lunch Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday; dinner Friday and Saturday. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers say the shop is run by two older women (September 2024; January 2025), “two ladies” (December 2025), two women (September 2026). The owner remembered a returning diner (January 2025) and cut the okonomiyaki and recommended Kyoto souvenirs for another (March 2026). Open since February 2020 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Manbo-yaki.

anecdotes.text: In October 2024 the proprietress asked a first-time diner how the Manbo-yaki had been heard of — tourists often ask what it is.
A February 2025 group tried Okocchobo from the photo at the door, and read up on Ochobo, a Taisho-era children’s snack.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お食事処 上田、お好み焼き、下京区下之町1-1-41、京阪七条から346m、京都駅から徒歩10分、火・木 11:00〜14:00、金・土 11:00〜14:00・17:30〜20:30、月・水・日曜定休、カード・電子マネー・QR決済不可、店の前に駐車可、2020年2月10日オープン。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 年配の女性2人で営む、元はバーの天井の高い広い店内、昭和のレトロなポスター、鉄板のテーブル3卓・約20席、豚入りのManbo-yaki 1,050円、ホソ増し1,150円、大 (麺の量) 1,250円 (そばかうどん、卵・紅しょうが・ねぎ入り)、豚玉850円、ホソ焼きそば900円・油かすのトッピング200円、Okocchobo 800円・卵100円 (ねぎ、揚げ玉、たくあん、ちくわ、こんにゃく、豆、醤油・七味・かつお節)、マヨネーズ50円、日替わりの豚バラの定食、甘口と辛口のソース・マヨネーズ・かつお節・青のりはセルフ、現金のみ、観光客によくManbo-yakiとは何かと聞かれる。

cultural_comfort.note: Homely local okonomiyaki shop; cash only; tourists often ask what Manbo-yaki is (October 2024).

existence.note: Tabelog listing checked 2026-11-26 (no closure badge); reviews dated September 2024 to September 2026.

kyoto_hamayaki_kushikatsu_shijo_omiya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a kushikatsu shop (battered, deep-fried skewers); the grilled turban shell is seasoned with soy sauce (July 2026); no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_hamayaki_kushikatsu_shijo_omiya.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable kushikatsu (okra, pumpkin, sweet potato) are on the menu, but nothing is described as vegan; the rest is seafood, meat and offal (2026 reviews).
kyoto_hamayaki_kushikatsu_shijo_omiya.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–02:00 (last orders 01:30), open year-round (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay; no e-money (Tabelog). 42 seats: 10 at the counter, 32 at tables; buyouts for 20–50 (Tabelog). Seats booked online may be allocated to “a different location” than the one chosen; ask by phone for counter or table (Tabelog). Seating limited to 2 hours when busy (Tabelog). Non-smoking, with a smoking area outside (Tabelog). By exit 5 of Hankyu Omiya, a few seconds’ walk (Tabelog; Gurunavi). Open since 17 July 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_hamayaki_kushikatsu_shijo_omiya.notes: [Seafood and kushikatsu · Shijo-Omiya, grilled at the table] A lively tavern steps from Hankyu Omiya where the staff grill clams, scallops, shrimp and squid at your table, with sashimi platters and crisp kushikatsu alongside. Counter seats for solo diners, tables for groups; open nightly until 02:00. Courses with all-you-can-drink from Tabelog.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog lists the shop as a corporate member and says online bookings may be seated at a different location than chosen; no operator or sister shop was found on Tabelog or Gurunavi. Open since July 2020 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Table-grilled seafood; kushikatsu.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner on a booked course had to remind the staff of the course, the closing rice dish and a points discount, yet left calling it a very good seafood grill.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 浜焼ボーイと串カツガール、居酒屋・海鮮・串揚げ、中京区錦大宮町154-5、阪急大宮駅から徒歩10秒、毎日 17:00〜翌2:00 (L.O. 1:30)、年中無休、カード・PayPay・d払い・楽天ペイ可、42席 (カウンター10、テーブル32)、貸切20〜50名、ネット予約の席は別の場所に案内される場合あり、混雑時は2時間制、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、2020年7月17日オープン、飲み放題90分付きの宴会コース6,800円 (税込)、刺身の盛り合わせ付きの浜焼コース (料理のみ) 3,800円 (税込)。ぐるなび: 錦大宮町154-5 1F、阪急大宮駅5番出口から徒歩1分。口コミ (2026年、英語): 店員がテーブルで焼く浜焼セット (白はまぐり、ホタテ、赤えび、イカ) 3,980円・4,378円、サザエ680円、刺身の盛り合わせ1,480円・1,628円 (Ehimeの本鮪、サーモン、焼いた鱧、ヒラマサ)、串カツ10本の盛り合わせ1,680円・1,848円 (鶏とチーズ、アジと大葉、えび、オクラ、かぼちゃ)、名物の塩もつ煮、たこの唐揚げ748円、二度づけ禁止。

cultural_comfort.note: Lively tavern; staff do the grilling at the table.

existence.note: Tabelog listing checked 2026-11-26 (no closure badge); Gurunavi listing; reviews dated April to July 2026.

kyoto_osteria_la_balena_nijo.gf_detail: Ask. Caprese, cured-ham platters and wagyu tagliata may suit, but the menu centres on wheat-dough pizza and pasta; no gluten information (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_osteria_la_balena_nijo.vegan_detail: Ask. A marinara pizza is on the menu (June 2026), but its ingredients are not described; most dishes use cheese, cured meat or seafood (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_osteria_la_balena_nijo.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–14:30 and 17:30–21:30; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); it is often fully booked, and an August 2026 regular advises booking by phone. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money (transport IC, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay) and QR (Tabelog). 23 seats (3 at the counter, 20 at tables); non-smoking with a smoking area; private hire for 20–50; take-out; no parking, coin parking nearby (Tabelog; August 2026 review). East of Nijo Castle, 335 m from Nijojo-mae Stn (Tabelog). No cover charge (June 2026 review). Reviewers differ on drinks: a June 2026 diner listed one drink per person as required, though not strictly enforced; a September 2026 diner found drinks not necessary at lunch. Opened 2 May 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_osteria_la_balena_nijo.notes: [Pizza · east of Nijo Castle] A popular 23-seat pizzeria with a wood-fired oven: chewy Neapolitan Margherita, Bismarck and prosciutto platters, a few minutes from Nijo Castle. Often fully booked — reserve by phone. Small kitchen team, so service can be slow.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a Neapolitan pizzeria opened May 2021 east of Nijo Castle. The owner cooks at the oven, with one other staff member serving (2024–2025 reviews); a weekday lunch in September 2026 was run by one person. A July 2024 diner described the owner as quiet and hard-working in the kitchen, and a June 2026 diner gathered that the owner is a Hanshin Tigers fan. Two 2024 reviewers mention many foreign visitors, and walk-ins without a seat buying pizza to take away (August and September 2024). An August 2025 diner found the service quite slow and advised ordering early. The Tabelog-listed website (pizzerialabalena.owst.jp) no longer loads (2026-11-26).
chef_bio.specialty: Wood-fired Neapolitan pizza.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner had come back three times “because the pizza is just too delicious”, with the buffalo-mozzarella Margherita, Bismarck and prosciutto platter.
A September 2026 lunch visitor walked in from Nijo Castle with no menu outside to go on, and the room was fully booked soon after.
On a snowy January 2023 lunchtime, the only diner in the room had the fried pizza lunch — not greasy and delicious.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・ピザ、中京区二条通堀川東入矢幡町313-3、二条城前駅から335m、毎日 12:00〜14:30、17:30〜21:30、不定休、予約可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners)・電子マネー (交通系IC・楽天Edy・nanaco・WAON・iD・QUICPay)・QR 可、23席 (カウンター3席、テーブル20席)、禁煙 (喫煙スペースあり)、20〜50名で貸切可、テイクアウト可、駐車場なし、2021年5月2日開店。口コミ (2023年1月〜2026年9月、英語): 二条城の東、青を基調にしたイタリアの内装、カウンターの奥に大きな薪窯、ナポリピッツァ、マルゲリータ、水牛モッツァレラのマルゲリータ、ビスマルク、クアトロ (はちみつ)、サラミ、マリナーラ、えび2種といかのマリナーラ、生ハムとルッコラ、日替わりのピッツァ、普通と小さめのサイズ、前菜の盛り合わせ、生ハムの盛り合わせ、カプレーゼ、たこといかのトマト煮、カルボナーラ、Akane 和牛のタリアータ、ティラミス、揚げピッツァのランチ (2023年1月)、店主とスタッフの2人、予約は電話で、満席が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone (Japanese); cards, IC and QR accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing fetched 2026-11-26 (no closure notice); reviews March, May, June, August and September 2026.

kyoto_kisetsu_ryori_nijojo_mae.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, grilled fish and rice may suit, but fried fish, fried chicken and croquettes are battered, and miso and simmered dishes are not described; no gluten information (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kisetsu_ryori_nijojo_mae.vegan_detail: Ask. Sets carry many vegetable side dishes (October 2025), but each centres on fish or meat, with miso soup whose stock is not described (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kisetsu_ryori_nijojo_mae.hours_raw: Breakfast Wednesday and Sunday 6:30–9:30, Thursday and Saturday 7:30–9:30; lunch Wednesday–Monday 11:45–13:45 (Monday to 14:00); dinner Wednesday–Monday 17:30–22:00 (Monday last food order 20:00, drinks 21:00); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Breakfast opens later on market days, after buying at the central wholesale market (August 2023; December 2024 — a Saturday opened at 8:00 instead of 7:30). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 4 seats; non-smoking; private hire possible (Tabelog). Up a narrow, steep staircase on the second floor, 2 min from Nijojo-mae Stn (Tabelog; October 2025); with only four seats, guests may wait downstairs (May 2024).
kyoto_kisetsu_ryori_nijojo_mae.notes: [Set meals · Nijojo-mae, 4 seats] A tiny upstairs counter run by a couple, open from 6:30 or 7:30 for breakfast: market-fresh sashimi, grilled and fried fish and many side dishes, cooked to order. Cash only; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a four-seat shop run by a couple — an August 2023 diner noted the cheerful, smiling owner and the shy owner’s skilled knife work; March and April 2024 reviews describe a husband-and-wife team. Ingredients are bought at the central wholesale market in the morning, so breakfast opens at 6:30 only on days the market is closed (August 2023; December 2024). One diner posted 71 visits between April 2023 and April 2024. Reviews are mostly warm; an April 2024 diner was bothered that the couple whispered to each other, a May 2024 diner noted higher prices, and an October 2025 diner waited 20–30 minutes for food cooked to order and found the mostly vegetable sets pricey. Reviewers mention international customers: quite a few lately, with the staff seeming stretched (May 2024); dishes geared towards inbound visitors (March 2026); a surprise to see international customers in so small a place (April 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase set meal; market-fresh fish.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 diner called it one of the restaurants that will flash before your eyes in a life review.
An August 2023 visitor came at 6:30 a.m. for the ¥880 breakfast before the tour groups, and found the homemade miso soup light and delicious.
A December 2024 diner queued first on a Saturday, and the shop opened at 8:00 because the morning’s buying ran late.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、中京区三坊猪熊町北組375-1 2F、二条城前駅から徒歩2分、月曜 11:45〜14:00、17:30〜22:00 (料理L.O.20:00、ドリンクL.O.21:00)、水・日 6:30〜9:30、11:45〜13:45、17:30〜22:00、木・土 7:30〜9:30、11:45〜13:45、17:30〜22:00、金曜 11:45〜13:45、17:30〜22:00、火曜定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、4席、禁煙、貸切可。口コミ (2023年4月〜2026年4月、英語): 夫婦で営む4席の店、中央卸売市場で朝仕入れ、冷凍の素材は使わない、朝食880円 (ご飯大盛り100円)、ご飯のおかわり150円、和朝食1,210円、刺身定食1,870円、一汁三菜の定食2,750円、おまかせ定食、おまかせ朝定食、刺身、塩焼きと味噌漬けの焼き魚、煮物、炊き込みご飯、赤だし、あじ・いわし・ます・まぐろのフライ、唐揚げ定食、かにクリームコロッケ、舌平目のムニエル、さばの刺身のポン酢、アイナメのフライ、みかんジュース、夜は5,000円ほどのコース、細く急な階段の2階。

cultural_comfort.note: Four seats, cash only; a December 2024 diner found the menu hard to read from the back seat, and the chef offered anything on it.

existence.note: Tabelog listing fetched 2026-11-26 (no closure notice); reviews June and October 2025, March and April 2026.

kyoto_le_temps_gouter_omiya.gf_detail: Ask. A baked-goods shop of canelés, financiers, chiffon cakes, cookies and pies; no gluten information (2022–2025 reviews).
kyoto_le_temps_gouter_omiya.vegan_detail: Ask. Financiers use browned butter, and Basque cheesecake, whipped cream and ice cream are dairy; the tofu chiffon cake’s other ingredients are not described (2022–2025 reviews).
kyoto_le_temps_gouter_omiya.hours_raw: Monday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday 12:00–18:00; closed Tuesday–Thursday (Tabelog). An October 2023 reviewer found the hours irregular and advised checking the shop’s Instagram first. Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog; December 2022 review). Takeaway and eat-in, with a separate window or counter for takeaway; counter for drinks, a raised seating area and space for small children (2022–2024 reviews). 7 min walk from Hankyu Omiya Stn (Tabelog). Opened 1 November 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_le_temps_gouter_omiya.notes: [Canelés · Takatsuji-Omiya] A small pastel café near Shijo-Omiya where the pastry chef bakes in view: crisp-shelled canelés in several flavours, browned-butter financiers, tofu chiffon cake and Basque cheesecake, to eat in or take away. Closed Tuesday–Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: opened in November 2022 in a spot that, a December 2022 reviewer wrote, used to be a coffee shop serving a few baked goods; the reviewer took the name to mean snack time in French. A female pastry chef can be watched making cakes and canelés through the window (July 2025). An April 2025 visitor found it a local favourite with gentle sweets but wished the coffee were better; a March 2023 visitor found most items sold out.
chef_bio.specialty: Canelés.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 passer-by watched the pastry chef at work through the window, then bought a small, moist Basque cheesecake.
A September 2024 visitor who thought it was takeout only found a relaxing room inside, and wanted a second cup of the milky café latte.
An April 2024 diner suggested trying two or three of the small canelés to sample flavours.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋菓子・カフェ、下京区高辻大宮町140、阪急大宮駅から徒歩7分、月・金・土・日 12:00〜18:00、火〜木休み、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2022年11月1日開店。口コミ (2022年12月〜2025年7月、英語): カヌレとフィナンシェの焼き菓子の店、白とパステルの内装、イートインとテイクアウト、ピスタチオとホワイトチョコのカヌレ280円 (税別)、フィナンシェ200円、ホットコーヒー480円、プレーン・キャラメル・イングリッシュティーの豆腐シフォン (プレーン250円、ホイップ120円)、ディアマンクッキー、スノーボールクッキー、ラムのカヌレ、チョコアーモンドのカヌレ、大小2サイズのカヌレ、バスクチーズケーキ、アップルパイ、プリン、ラムレーズンのアイス、カヌレのラスク、カフェラテ、窓越しに菓子職人の仕事が見える、営業日は Instagram で確認を (2023年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the window; cashless payment accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing fetched 2026-11-26 (no closure notice); latest reviews April and July 2025 (a November 2025 review is listed but not read); no official site found.

kyoto_marufuku_shiokoji.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the soba is 80/20 (twenty per cent wheat flour, March 2025 and January 2026 reviews), and udon, tempura and the soy-based dipping sauce contain wheat.
kyoto_marufuku_shiokoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soba and udon are served in dashi broth or dipping sauce; toppings include shrimp tempura, herring and chicken (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_marufuku_shiokoji.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Friday and Saturday 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–21:00; closed Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday (Tabelog). A September 2025 diner had walked past several times before finding it open. No reservations (Tabelog), though a July 2026 visitor booked for a Saturday at about 14:00. Cards: AMEX only; no e-money or QR (Tabelog), though a July 2026 diner paid by an electronic post-paid method. 40 seats (16 at tables, 16 on a raised floor, 8 at the counter); non-smoking; no parking (Tabelog). On Higashinotoin-dori just north of Shiokoji, east of Kyoto Tower, about 5 min from Kyoto Station (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_marufuku_shiokoji.notes: [Soba · near Kyoto Station] An old-fashioned soba shop five minutes north of the station: zaru soba with a mini oyakodon or tempura bowl, tempura zaru soba and Kyoto nishin soba, with a bottle of beer. Closed Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a soba and udon shop dating from the early Showa era (June 2026 review), with regulars and office workers among its guests (December 2025). Reviewers praise the firm, thin 80/20 soba and attentive, experienced staff; a September 2025 diner found the soba average and the mini tempura bowl too salty, a February 2026 diner found it ordinary, an October 2026 diner missed a wet towel, and a November 2026 diner found the nishin soba good but pricey.
chef_bio.specialty: Zaru soba sets; tempura zaru soba.

anecdotes.text: A November 2026 diner, whose first-choice soba shop was too crowded, found the nishin soba just like the one the diner’s mother used to make at home.
A June 2026 visitor unwound with a chilled Kirin bottle and smooth zaru soba in the Showa-retro room.
A March 2025 regular called it a long-time favourite and recommended the Ougon soba of stone-ground domestic buckwheat.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: そば・うどん・天丼、下京区東洞院通七条下ル塩小路町530-5、京都駅から379m、月・火・金・土 11:30〜15:00、18:00〜21:00、水・木・日休み、予約不可、カードは AMEX のみ、電子マネー・QR 不可、40席 (テーブル16席、小上がり16席、カウンター8席)、禁煙、駐車場なし。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年11月、英語): 昭和初期からの老舗、二八そば、天ざるそば1,600円 (えび2本と野菜の天ぷら)、Ougon soba 1,100円 (国産の石臼挽きのそば粉)、にしんそば1,550円、ミニ親子丼とざるそばの定食1,130円 (2026年1月) と ミニ親子丼定食(ざるそば) 1,230円 (2026年7月のメニュー)、ミニ天丼とかけそばの定食1,180円、大盛り300円、うなぎの天ぷらの丼、細うどんを始めた (2026年4月)、瓶ビール、そば湯、京都タワーの東。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash or AMEX per Tabelog; set meals listed on the menu.

existence.note: Tabelog listing fetched 2026-11-26 (no closure notice); reviews through November 2026.

kyoto_shishiou.gf_detail: GF — ask: no gluten-free claim on the shop’s site or Tabelog. The courses include kakiage and tempura, ankake and dashi dishes (official sample menu, autumn 2026; April 2022 review); the menu changes with the day’s market, so ask when booking.
kyoto_shishiou.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-based kaiseki courses with sashimi, pike conger, dobin-mushi and sea bream broth (official sample menu, autumn 2026).
kyoto_shishiou.hours_raw: Dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order 22:00); closed irregularly (official site). Tabelog lists every day 18:00–22:00 and says the shop closes on days without reservations; reservations only (Tabelog; online booking until 23:00 the day before), though a July 2026 diner staying nearby was seated without one. Lunch by reservation only, for 4 or more, by phone at least 2 days ahead (official site; Tabelog). 50 seats: a first-floor counter for solo diners, sunken kotatsu tables, and second-floor tatami rooms that join into a banquet room for up to 30 (official site; Tabelog). Cards (Visa, Mastercard, AMEX, JCB, Diners, Discover, UnionPay) and QR (PayPay, WeChat Pay, Alipay+) (official site). Non-smoking with a smoking space; no parking; children welcome but no kids’ menu, so call ahead (Tabelog). 5 minutes’ walk from Nijojo-mae Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_shishiou.notes: [Kaiseki · Nijo Castle] A thirty-year-old Kyoto cuisine restaurant near Nijo Castle whose owner was head chef at a Gion restaurant: eight-dish kyo-kuzushi kaiseki courses from ¥5,000 to ¥7,000, generous and playfully plated, with sake tastings to choose a bottle. Counter, sunken tables and tatami rooms for up to 30. Dinner by reservation; lunch for groups of 4 or more.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the restaurant has been open for thirty years; the owner trained for years at a Gion restaurant and became its head chef, and built the kyo-kuzushi style on that. The courses change daily with the owner’s morning market buying while the number of dishes and the price stay fixed (official English site). Reviewers describe a talkative, friendly owner (January 2023, July 2025, December 2025, July 2026) whose conversation lifted the mood without ever talking down (May 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: The official site says the restaurant wants every guest to enjoy Japanese cuisine without formality.
chef_bio.specialty: Eight-dish kyo-kuzushi kaiseki; sea bream chazuke to finish.

anecdotes.text: A December 2024 diner on a business trip booked for Christmas Eve, and the owner thanked the diner for choosing Japanese food on Christmas.
A June 2026 diner arrived thirty minutes early for a colleague’s farewell dinner, was welcomed anyway, tasted four sakes before choosing, and was seen off at the door after paying.
A July 2025 reviewer warned light eaters that the portions are large, and explained that the course prices differ in the kinds of sashimi included.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京くずし料理 しし翁、京都・二条城のほど近く、三十年、店主は祇園の料理屋で修業し料理長を務めた。夜 18:00〜22:00 (L.O.22:00)、不定休、昼は完全予約制 (4名様以上・2日前までに電話で)。京くずし会席 8品 7,000円・6,000円・5,000円、飲み放題ご宴会 6品 6,000円 (6名様から)、昼 7品 4,500円・4,000円・3,500円。2026年秋の一例: 季節の八寸、京野菜と鱧のあんかけ、お造り4種盛り、イカのバジル焼き、黒豆枝豆と鱧のかき揚げ、土瓶蒸し、鯛の焼きおにぎりの鯛出汁茶漬け、シャーベット。1月1日〜5日は7,000円のみ、10,000円程度の特別会席も相談可。食べログ: 京･くずし料理 しし翁 (シシオウ)、中京区小川通二条下ル古城町367-14、二条城前駅から徒歩5分、予約のみ、50席 (カウンター・掘りごたつ・座敷)、2階座敷は最大30名、カード・QR可。口コミ (2022年1月〜2026年9月、英語): 話し好きで気さくな店主、量が多い、日本酒を3〜4種試飲して選べる、コストパフォーマンスがよい。

cultural_comfort.note: The shop has an English website and online booking. Tabelog warns that phone service may be in Japanese only; no evidence of spoken English. A December 2024 Japanese diner helped translate for overseas guests.

existence.note: Official site with autumn 2026 menu; Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_enmusubi_ajikonbu.gf_detail: GF — ask: no gluten-free claim. The onigiri are filled with the shop’s own seasoned kombu (with shiitake and sansho, February 2026), whose seasonings are not stated; the obanzai tray has included spring rolls (October 2025, December 2025, August 2026), and nama-fu has been served (April 2026).
kyoto_enmusubi_ajikonbu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the obanzai include fish, chicken and dried sardines, with miso soup (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_enmusubi_ajikonbu.hours_raw: Tabelog: lunch 11:00–14:00 on Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays; closed Wednesday and Thursday; closing days vary, so check the operating calendar on Instagram. Reservations by phone or Instagram DM, booking early recommended (Tabelog); the lunch is limited to 20 meals (August 2024 and February 2026 reviews) and an August 2026 photo shows booking by time slot, though a November 2025 couple was seated without a booking. Evening service is not on Tabelog, but reviewers ate and drank there at night in October 2025, January, April and August 2026; an August 2026 regular wrote that the evening hours would change from the next week. 8 counter seats (August and October 2025); an August 2026 party sat in a private room for 6. Cards (JCB) and e-money; no QR payments; no parking (Tabelog) — an August 2025 diner used a paid lot nearby. Opened 22 October 2022 (Tabelog). 4 minutes’ walk from Hankyu Omiya Station.
kyoto_enmusubi_ajikonbu.notes: [Obanzai · Shijo Omiya] A small counter in a renovated machiya down an alley off Inokuma-dori, reached through a gate and a path: a ¥1,500 obanzai lunch of five to eight small dishes with onigiri filled with the house kombu, limited to 20 a day, and obanzai with sake at night. Reserve ahead; closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Opened on 22 October 2022 (Tabelog). An October 2025 reviewer found the owner running the whole shop alone and chatting over the counter; an April 2026 regular mentions the cheerful owner. A November 2025 reviewer says the kombu has been handed down through three generations and took some home; a February 2026 reviewer describes it as homemade kombu with large pieces of shiitake and a hint of sansho. The room is finished in black with an L-shaped counter (September 2025, February 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Onigiri filled with the house aji-kombu; obanzai.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 parent struggling to find a Kyoto lunch spot that took children booked by phone; children who do not order the lunch sit on a booster seat, which went on a round backless stool, and the reviewer still called the ¥1,500 lunch a great value.
An October 2026 reviewer called it a deli-style place for sake lovers who prefer light food, not for anyone, especially families, after a hearty meal.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京 縁結び味こんぶ、その他、下京区瀬戸屋町305、阪急大宮駅から徒歩4分、月・火・金・土・日・祝 11:00〜14:00、水・木休み、休みは不定でInstagramの営業カレンダーで確認、電話かInstagramのDMで予約、カード (JCB)・電子マネー可、QR不可、カウンター席、駐車場なし、2022年10月22日オープン。口コミ (2024年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 猪熊通から路地を入った町家、門から小道を通って入る、カウンター8席、おばんざいとおむすびのランチ1,500円 (20食限定)、自家製の味こんぶのおむすび、夜はおばんざいと日本酒、店主がひとりで切り盛り、こんぶは三代受け継いだもの。

cultural_comfort.note: One set lunch, served at the counter; booking by phone or Instagram DM. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_sake_cube.gf_detail: GF — ask: a sake shop with a standing bar; no food beyond snacks such as dried foods and canned fish (June 2022). Sake is made from rice, but beer is also sold; no gluten-free claim.
kyoto_sake_cube.vegan_detail: Vegan — ask: drinks by the glass; the only food reviewers mention is dried snacks and canned goods such as oil sardines (June 2022). No vegan claim.
kyoto_sake_cube.hours_raw: Shop open Mon–Sat 11:30–21:00; closed Sunday and holidays (official site). Tabelog gives Mon–Sat 11:00–21:00. A March 2026 reviewer was told the in-store drinking (kaku-uchi) starts at 16:00. Reservations taken; private hire available; counter and standing bar; non-smoking; cards and QR payments; no parking (Tabelog); a large table in the middle of the shop (August 2026). On Nijo-dori west of Nishinotoin, about 480 m from Nijojo-mae Station.
kyoto_sake_cube.notes: [Sake bar · Nijo-dori] A sake shop the site says has sold drinks on this street between Nijo Castle and the Imperial Palace for over a hundred years, now a bright, wood-lined shop with a kaku-uchi standing bar: try Kyoto sake by the glass from about ¥500 and buy the bottle you like. Drinking from 16:00 (March 2026 review). Closed Sunday and holidays.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the shop has sold drinks on this spot between Nijo Castle and the Imperial Palace for more than a hundred years, and means to keep changing with the times as a sake shop. The site lists exhibitions of a Japanese photographer’s pictures of overseas cities, a Hong Kong craft-art show and talk, and a SAKE CUBE KYOTO stall at a fair in Hong Kong. A June 2022 reviewer described an elegant standing bar run by a young couple; a May 2026 reviewer noted the artwork on display is by an artist who is a customer.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto sake by the glass, bottles to take home.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor came on a weekday before 16:00, learned the drinking started at 16:00, came back at 16:30, and bought the bottle of Ura Kamikura after tasting it; the pours were generous.
An August 2024 reviewer, a Kamikura fan, noted that a bottle bought in the shop can be opened at the bar and the rest taken home.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: SAKE CUBE、二条城と御所を結ぶこの地でお酒の販売と共に100余年、時代と共に変化する酒屋、京都の日本酒を中心にビール・ワインを販売、木の温もりを感じる店内で角打ちを楽しめる、月〜土 11:30〜21:00、日・祝定休、中京区二条通西洞院西入西大黒町343、写真展や香港のクラフトアートの展示などのイベント。食べログ: SAKE CUBE KYOTO (サケキューブ キョウト)、日本酒バー、大黒町343、月〜土 11:00〜21:00、日・祝休み、予約可、貸切可、禁煙、カード・QR可、カウンター・立ち飲み。口コミ (2019年5月〜2026年11月、英語): 酒屋の角打ち、1杯500円ほどから、Matsui Shuzo の Kamikura、角打ちは16時から (2026年3月)、気に入った酒はその場で買える。

cultural_comfort.note: Standing bar inside a sake shop; bottles on display to point at. No English evidence found (the official site is in Japanese).

existence.note: Official site; Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_sake_cube.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260203/26029552/ (35.013548, 135.755017); not cross-checked (worker, no OSM this round); 2026-11-26

kyoto_kurakura.gf_detail: GF — ask: no gluten-free claim. Sashimi, grilled fish and robatayaki sit beside tempura, karaage and fried nama-fu (official menu); yakitori comes with sauce or salt, and seasonings are not stated.
kyoto_kurakura.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood and yakitori izakaya; the September 2026 otoshi included chicken gizzards and walnuts with bonito flakes, and eggplant came simmered in dashi with shishamo.
kyoto_kurakura.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00, last orders 22:00 for food and 22:30 for drinks (official site); Tabelog gives Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00, last order 22:30, closed Sunday. Regular closing days are Sunday and the second Monday, with extra closures posted each month (official news, November 2026: also closed 4 and 23 November). Reservations taken; a November 2026 diner phoned ahead on a holiday weekend and got a table (Tabelog; review). Counter and tatami table seating; parties of 4 to 20 (official site); the second floor, used for company parties decades ago (September 2026), was cleared and reopened after years as storage (shop’s Instagram, undated). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR; non-smoking; no parking (Tabelog). About 4–7 minutes’ walk from Kyoto Station.
kyoto_kurakura.notes: [Izakaya · Kyoto Station] A hideaway izakaya in a renovated Taisho-era sake brewery building down a quiet street north of Shichijo, open near Kyoto Station for over thirty years: seasonal sashimi, robatayaki, taro tempura and dashimaki, with a long list of sake. Counter and tatami seating; parties up to 20. Closed Sunday and the second Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: an izakaya that has been near Kyoto Station for more than thirty years, in a renovated Taisho-era sake brewery building (the entrance sign said so, January 2026). A September 2026 diner remembered company year-end parties there almost thirty years earlier; a March 2026 regular first came over eighteen years ago. The shop’s own Instagram posts (undated, shown on its site) say foreign customers have increased, and that the staff felt down about staff shortages and too little English for foreign guests.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal sashimi and sake.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 reviewer praised the knife work on a three-kind sashimi platter, plump raw oysters, taro tempura good with just salt, and grilled shirako with sake.
A June 2026 reviewer expected fewer foreign customers because the shop is tucked away, while June and September 2026 diners found it lively with people of all ages from Japan and abroad.
A June 2026 reviewer warned that the wooden floor and tatami seating can be hard on the back over a long sitting.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 大正時代の酒蔵を改装した隠れ家居酒屋 蔵倉、京都駅前で30数年、カウンターと座敷のテーブル席、4名様〜20名様の宴会可、17:00〜23:00 (料理L.O.22:00、ドリンクL.O.22:30)、下京区飴屋町244 木村ビル。お品書き (税込、夏の一例): 天然 鯛・しまあじ・剣先いか 各1,450円、はもおとし・たたき1,800円〜、盛り合わせ3種1,600円〜・5種2,400円〜、天草 生がき1,200円、はまぐり酒蒸し・焼1,320円、はも天ぷら1,600円〜、明太子680円、手羽先唐揚750円、ほっけ1,500円、生麩あげだし1,000円、やきとり3本660円、つくね2本660円、生ビール中800円、地酒冷酒750円〜2,000円、熱燗一合600円。お知らせ (2026年10月30日): 日曜日と第二月曜日が定休日、11月は4日と23日も臨時休業。Instagram (日付なし): 外国人のお客様も増えてきた、英語力不足に落ち込んだ、物置のようになっていた2階を数年ぶりに使う。食べログ: 蔵倉 (クラクラ)、居酒屋、東洞院通七条上る飴屋町244、京都駅から徒歩約4分、月〜土 17:00〜23:00、日曜休み、カード可。

cultural_comfort.note: Many foreign customers (shop’s Instagram; 2026 reviews), but the shop’s own post says the staff’s English is limited. Tabelog warns that phone service may be in Japanese only.

existence.note: Official site with a November 2026 closing-day notice; Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.
