kyoto_sumibi_unagi_tb26042193.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as served: the eel is glazed with a house tare (reviews), and no gluten information is published; ask about salt-grilled wagyu.
kyoto_sumibi_unagi_tb26042193.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel and wagyu restaurant.
kyoto_sumibi_unagi_tb26042193.hours_raw: 11:00–21:00 daily including holidays (last order 20:00); 29 December–4 January 11:00–20:00 (last order 19:00) (Tabelog). HotPepper gives last orders at 19:30 and no regular closing day. Bookings taken, online through Tabelog (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR payments (PayPay, Rakuten Pay, au PAY; Alipay on Tabelog); e-money accepted per Tabelog, not accepted per HotPepper. 61 seats (Tabelog) or 80 (HotPepper); no private rooms. Non-smoking. No parking. By the pond inside Maruyama Park, about 10 minutes on foot from Keihan Gion-Shijo through Yasaka Shrine (Tabelog). Opened 16 November 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sumibi_unagi_tb26042193.notes: [Unagi · Maruyama Park, charcoal eel by the pond] Charcoal-grilled domestic eel in a Japanese-style building by the pond in Maruyama Park: unaju with a whole eel, and a bowl that pairs eel with A5 wagyu sirloin. Window tables look over the garden and pond. Open all day from 11:00; bookings taken.

chef_bio.background: Opened on 16 November 2024 (Tabelog). By the pond in the Japanese garden of Maruyama Park, south of Yasaka Shrine (May–June 2026 reviews). A June 2026 reviewer heard the building was once a teahouse and describes a calm modern-Japanese room of warm wood with large windows on the garden and pond; the grill can be watched from inside and outside (June 2026). HotPepper describes skilled craftsmen grilling selected domestic eel over charcoal one skewer at a time. A May 2026 reviewer noticed many visitors from overseas.
chef_bio.specialty: Unaju with a whole domestic eel; eel and A5 wagyu sirloin bowl.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 couple arrived just after 11:00, well before the booked time, and got a window table looking over the weeping cherry and the pond — enough to order unplanned wine.
A June 2026 diner timed it: seated two minutes after arriving at 12:50 on a Sunday with a booking, beer on the table by 12:59, and a whole eel so long it seemed ready to leap out of the box.
A local who came in July 2026 had not known the place existed until recently, about a year after it opened, and was struck by how fresh the eel soup tasted.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 京都 炭火鰻 翠川 祇園八坂、うなぎ・日本料理・甘味処、京都市東山区円山町467、京阪祇園四条駅から八坂神社を抜けて徒歩約10分、毎日11:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:00)、12月29日〜1月4日は11:00〜20:00、予約可、カード可、電子マネー可、QRコード決済可、61席、個室なし、全席禁煙、駐車場なし、オープン日2024年11月16日。ホットペッパー: 月〜日11:00〜21:00 (料理L.O.19:30、ドリンクL.O.19:30)、定休日なし、80席、全席禁煙、電子マネー利用不可、厳選された国産鰻を熟練の職人が一串一串、丁寧に炭火で調理、鰻重・鰻丼、A5黒毛和牛サーロインと鰻重。口コミ (2026年5〜7月、英語): 円山公園の池のそば、窓から庭と池、関西風の炭火焼き、鰻重 (上) 7,700円 (肝吸い、うざく、香の物付き)、国産鰻とA5和牛サーロインの重8,800円 (2026年5月)、2026年5〜6月は鰻重7,000円と鰻と和牛の重8,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas visitors (May 2026 review); bookings online.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (corporate member) and HotPepper; reviews dated May–July 2026.

kyoto_kiseki_fuyacho.gf_detail: Ask. Seafood, meat and vegetables grilled over charcoal at the table, horse and chicken sashimi, sea bream rice; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_kiseki_fuyacho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood and meat grill; vegetables are grilled too, but no vegan information is published.
kyoto_kiseki_fuyacho.hours_raw: 18:00–23:00 daily including holidays (last order 22:00), closed irregularly (official site; Tabelog). Bookings by phone (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no debit cards, e-money or QR payments (Tabelog). 24 seats with counter seating and two semi-private rooms for 6–10 and 12–14; up to 24 seated or 40 standing for parties (official site; Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). All-you-can-drink available; English menu (Tabelog). On the ground floor of the 塩田ビル on Fuyacho south of Nijo, 5 minutes from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae station, exit 9 at Zest Oike (official site; Tabelog). Opened 7 October 2015 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kiseki_fuyacho.notes: [Izakaya · Fuyacho-Nijo, irori charcoal grill] A charcoal-grill izakaya where every table has an irori hearth: seafood such as sea urchin, scallops and yellowtail collar grilled in front of you, horse and chicken sashimi, and sea bream rice, with sake and shochu. Several reviewers note slow service. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Opened on 7 October 2015 (Tabelog); the official site marks its 11th anniversary. gurunavi says the owner picks the seasonal ingredients. A December 2024 reviewer found the owner approachable and warm; a March 2024 reviewer thought it family-run, seeing the owner’s children at the shop, and found it hard for the owner to manage alone at that size. The official site says the horse sashimi has impressed people from Kumamoto.
chef_bio.philosophy: Local sake and fresh seasonal ingredients grilled over charcoal (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Seafood grilled over charcoal at the irori; horse sashimi.

anecdotes.text: A November 2024 traveller, finding everything closed on a Wednesday night, phoned without a booking; the person on the phone gave directions from the hotel, and the ¥11,000 course of seafood, vegetables and beef seemed half the price it would be in Tokyo.
In August 2019 a diner liked grilling at the irori but found the room so hot in summer, with every table’s hearth lit, that the air conditioning could not keep up; the service was slow.
A July 2024 visitor expected to grill anything and found only a limited selection could be grilled at the table, but tried grilled sea urchin for the first time and loved it.
A November 2025 diner praised the top-quality seafood but called the service slow and, with the long waits, the value low.
A January 2024 guest noted that charcoal was not used that evening, but enjoyed the meat, a generous grilled amberjack collar and the rice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 炭火焼 木石、全席囲炉裏完備の炭火焼専門店、美味しい地酒と新鮮な旬の素材を炭火焼きで、11周年、海鮮盛り1,000円 (税込)、馬刺し 赤身800円 (税込)、鶏刺し1,500円 (税込)、鹿児島地鶏刺し、熊本の方も唸った馬刺し、総席数24席、18:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、定休日なし (不定休日あり)、京都府京都市中京区麩屋町通二条下ル尾張町220-1 塩田ビル1F、地下鉄東西線京都市役所前駅から徒歩5分。ぐるなび: 炭火焼 木石 (スミビヤキキセキ)、店主自らが選び抜いた旬の食材、シェフがいる、テーブル個室あり。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 海鮮・もつ鍋・居酒屋、毎日18:00〜23:00、不定休、予約可、カード可、デビットカード不可、24席、半個室 (6〜10名、12〜14名)、喫煙可、飲み放題、英語メニュー、オープン日2015年10月7日。口コミ (2019〜2026年、英語): 囲炉裏で焼く、焼きウニ、提供が遅い (2019年8月、2024年3月、2025年11月)、夏は暑い (2019年8月)、11,000円のコース (2024年11月)、鯛めし (2024年6月、2026年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); smoking allowed.

existence.note: Official site (11th anniversary) and Tabelog listing (corporate member); reviews dated November and December 2025 and March 2026.

kyoto_steak_house_ashiya.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan-grilled wagyu steak courses with salad, potatoes with butter and dessert; no gluten information is published (gurunavi; reviews).
kyoto_steak_house_ashiya.hours_raw: Wednesday–Sunday 17:30–22:00, closed Monday and Tuesday (Tabelog); gurunavi gives 17:30–21:00. Reservation only; seat requests are not taken, as seating depends on party size (Tabelog; gurunavi). No preschool children (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Prices include service charge and tax (Tabelog). 15 seats, all at a sunken-kotatsu counter in a tatami room (Tabelog; gurunavi); private hire up to 20. Non-smoking. English menu (Tabelog). A maiko visit can be arranged for an extra fee, by reservation (Tabelog). In a back alley near Kiyomizu-dera, on Matsubara east of Hiromichi (gurunavi address; 2016 review). The website listed on Tabelog (steak-house-ashiya.com) did not resolve on 26 November 2026.
kyoto_steak_house_ashiya.notes: [Steak · Kiyomizu, a steakhouse since 1970] A teppan steakhouse in an old Japanese house near Kiyomizu-dera, which calls itself Kyoto's first steakhouse, since 1970: wagyu grilled in front of you at a sunken counter over the garden, with a gallery upstairs of photos of famous guests. Reviewers love the playful proprietress. Reservation only; a maiko visit can be arranged.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog (official information): "We have been operating as Kyoto’s first steakhouse since 1970." gurunavi: opened over 40 years ago in a renovated traditional Japanese house, with a skilled owner and a playful proprietress (お茶目な女将). Reviewers give the history as about 50 years (December 2013) and recall visiting with family over 50 years earlier, when the owner was an American and many customers were Americans (May 2014). That May 2014 reviewer says the American owner has since died and the proprietress now runs the restaurant; a December 2013 reviewer says the proprietress’s husband is American. Reviewers describe celebrity guests, including President Clinton and Hollywood stars (December 2013; May 2015), a red fan at the entrance in memory of the late actor Ken Takakura (December 2013), and an upstairs gallery of photos of notable guests (May 2015). An April 2026 reviewer heard that about 80% of customers come from overseas.
chef_bio.philosophy: Hospitality unchanged since it opened (gurunavi).
chef_bio.specialty: Teppan-grilled wagyu steak courses; steamed potatoes with butter.

anecdotes.text: A May 2014 diner, back after several decades, found the steamed potatoes with butter that had seemed so strange as a child still on the menu, though the chef of old heaped on far more butter.

A review dated May 2015 tells of a Christmas Eve visit: a couple got a same-day booking, were greeted at the door by the proprietress, toured the upstairs gallery, and ended with a surprise the reviewer kept secret.
An August 2018 visitor found the building old enough to be a little worrying and the food somewhat lacking, but wanted to come back just to see the owner again.
A December 2013 reviewer called the proprietress the most entertaining hostess in Kyoto and urged readers to go while the proprietress is still lively.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): ステーキハウス 芦屋、ステーキ・洋食・鉄板焼き、京都市東山区清水4-172-13、水〜日17:30〜22:00、月・火定休、完全予約制、席の指定不可、掘りごたつのカウンター15席、未就学児不可、カード可、表示料金にはサービス料と消費税を含む、全席禁煙、英語メニュー、1970年から京都初のステーキハウス、舞妓の手配可 (有料、要予約)。ぐるなび: ステーキハウス 芦屋 (ステーキハウスアシヤ)、清水寺付近の隠れ家、腕利きの店主とお茶目な女将、四十数年前に伝統的な日本家屋を改築して開業、開業40年以来変わらぬおもてなし、17:30〜21:00、月・火定休、15席、ステーキ100gコース12,000円、150gコース18,000円、200gコース23,000円、席の指定は一切お断り。口コミ (2013〜2026年、英語): 約50年の歴史 (2013年12月)、アメリカ人の店主は亡くなり今は女将が切り盛り (2014年5月)、じゃがバター、2階のギャラリー (2015年5月)、客の約8割が海外から (2026年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); about 80% of guests from overseas (April 2026 review). Reservation only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (corporate member) and gurunavi; review dated April 2026. The website on Tabelog did not resolve on 2026-11-26.

kyoto_and_hoek_gojo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a café of pies, tarts, cakes and baked goods (reviews; rurubu); no gluten-free item is mentioned.
kyoto_and_hoek_gojo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream pies, cheesecake and panna cotta; oat milk can be added to lattes for ¥50 (November 2026).
kyoto_and_hoek_gojo.hours_raw: Wednesday–Sunday 10:00–17:00, closed Monday and Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog; rurubu). A September 2026 review quoting the shop gives 10:00–18:00. No seat bookings, and items cannot be held; takeaway of cakes and baked goods (Tabelog; November 2026 review). Order and pay at the counter on the 1st floor first; self-service water; no time limit (August and November 2026 reviews). Lines form before opening on weekends, and the pies sell out by early afternoon (2026 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). Non-smoking. Counter seats and window seats on the 1st floor, more seating on the 2nd floor (2026 reviews; rurubu). About 6 minutes on foot from Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo (rurubu). Opened 28 December 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_and_hoek_gojo.notes: [Café · Kiyomizu-Gojo, seasonal fruit pies] A café in a renovated wooden machiya, opened in December 2025 by two friends who had dreamed of running a café together since high school: big seasonal fruit pies such as the caramel fig and strawberry caramel, cakes and baked goods. Popular — lines before opening on weekends, pies sold out by early afternoon. Order and pay first; no seat bookings.

chef_bio.background: rurubu: two women who were high-school classmates made the shared dream of running a café together come true at Kiyomizu-Gojo; fans of the sweets and of the gentle atmosphere the two create are growing fast. Opened on 28 December 2025 (Tabelog) in a renovated traditional wooden house (November 2026 review). A November 2026 reviewer came after seeing the café on TV.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal fruit pies: caramel fig, strawberry caramel, marron cream.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 visitor who had read the pies sell out by 15:00 came as a second stop and learned while still in line that the fig caramel pie had sold out — then watched the banana caramel pie go too, and settled happily for a fig and tea Victoria cake.
A September 2026 diner who saw on Instagram that the fig pie sells out around 13:00–14:00 arrived at 10:30 and found the pie large and full of whole figs.
A November 2026 visitor found the 1st floor full, was seated upstairs in a high-ceilinged room with big windows, and spent ¥1,650 on pie and coffee before a line formed outside.
A Saturday-afternoon visitor in August 2026 queued to pay, found the room full of young women and couples, and planned a quieter weekday next time.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: るるぶ&more: ＆Hoek (アンドフーク、あんどふーく)、京都府京都市東山区下新シ町345、10〜17時、月・火曜休み、京阪清水五条駅から徒歩6分、駐車場なし、高校の同級生だった女の子2人が「一緒にカフェをやる！」という夢を清水五条で叶えた店、旬のフルーツを使ったケーキ、焼き菓子のテイクアウト、クッキー缶は母の日、父の日など記念日限定、カウンター席。食べログ: &Hoek、カフェ、水〜日10:00〜17:00、月・火定休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QRコード決済可、全席禁煙、オープン日2025年12月28日。口コミ (2026年、英語): キャラメル無花果パイ850円 (Joyo のいちじく、2026年9月)、いちごのキャラメルパイ1,100円 (2026年11月)、マロンクリームパイ (2026年10月)、レモンパイ (2026年7月)、先に1階で注文と支払い、週末は開店前から行列、パイは昼過ぎに売り切れ。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay at the 1st-floor counter; no seat bookings.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and rurubu; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_dining_bar_tb26035847_gojo.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta (venison Bolognese, yellowtail with pesto), fish fried or topped with herb breadcrumbs, pâté and bread served with the meat are on the menu (2025–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_dining_bar_tb26035847_gojo.vegan_detail: Ask. The five-vegetable appetizer plate is a favourite, but a November 2025 plate included potato salad with anchovy and persimmon with butter; most other dishes are meat, game and fish (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_dining_bar_tb26035847_gojo.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 15:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Wednesdays, plus irregular closing days (Tabelog). Reservations by Instagram DM (Tabelog; a May 2024 reviewer booked that way). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). A November 2023 reviewer noted a house rule that groups of three or more order at least six dishes. Shoes off in the main room: sofa seats and mismatched tables, plus a brighter counter (2024–25 reviews). Non-smoking (Tabelog). An old townhouse with an ivy-covered entrance among houses in a residential street, 3 min walk west of Exit 8 of Gojo Stn, 257 m (Tabelog; 2024–25 reviews). Bicycles can be left in front of the bicycle shop (Tabelog). Opened 18 April 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_dining_bar_tb26035847_gojo.notes: [Dining bar · Gojo] An old townhouse behind an ivy-hung door west of Gojo Stn: shoes off, sofas and antique furniture, records playing, and wine with plates of seasonal vegetables, pâté, game and pasta. About ¥4,000–6,000; cash only; book by Instagram DM.

chef_bio.background: Opened 18 April 2021 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe a dim, wooden old house with antique furniture and records playing (2024–26), the room "like my grandparents' house" with tables spaced apart (August 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Five-vegetable appetizer plate; pâté de campagne; game dishes; wine.

anecdotes.text: A party of three in May 2024 found the drink list mostly in English, but a staff member described each of five white wines and their labels; the bill came with the three-way split written beside it, about ¥6,000 each.
A November 2023 reviewer liked the marinated kochoudai and turnip gratin, but noted that the posted rules did not mention that groups of three or more must order at least six dishes.
Kenji Ozawa's "LIFE" was on the turntable during an October 2024 visit; the reviewer left soon after dessert as the dessert menu had no drinks.
A March 2026 visitor found the loud music inside a funny contrast with the quiet exterior, and liked the chewy bread that came with the meat.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お皿とスプーン、ダイニングバー、下京区銭屋町249、五条駅8番出口から西へ徒歩3分 (257m)、月火木金土日 15:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、水曜休み、不定休、予約は Instagram の DM、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、禁煙、カウンター席、2021年4月18日オープン。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 住宅街の古い町家、つたの入口、靴を脱ぐソファ席、アンティークの家具、レコードの音楽、野菜の前菜5種盛り、パテ・ド・カンパーニュ、ジビエ、パスタ、ワイン、1人4,000〜6,000円ほど、3人以上は6品以上の注文 (2023年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Drink list mostly in English and staff who explain the wines (May 2024 review); booking by Instagram DM (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_izakaya_tb26032487_teramachi.gf_detail: Ask. Fried dishes — chicken nanban, Tatsuta-style karaage, fried horse mackerel — anchor the lunch sets, and bonito is marinated in sweet soy sauce (2024–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_izakaya_tb26032487_teramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken and fish izakaya; the lunch soup is made with dashi (February and September 2026 reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_tb26032487_teramachi.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–23:00; closed Wednesdays (Tabelog). Reservations taken; courses from ¥6,000 including tax, with the details arranged by phone (Tabelog). Appetizer charge ¥500 per person (Tabelog, original text お通し代としてお一人様当たり５００円（税込）). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 36 seats: a ground-floor counter and an upstairs room; private use possible (Tabelog). A September 2025 reviewer describes a private room for four and an upstairs space for up to 24 for private bookings. Heated tobacco only, in a designated area (Tabelog). School-age children welcome (Tabelog); takeaway (Tabelog). On Teramachi-dori north of Takeyamachi, a big lantern at the door; 10 min walk from Keihan Jingu-Marutamachi Stn and from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn, 488 m from Jingu-Marutamachi (Tabelog; April 2024 review).
kyoto_izakaya_tb26032487_teramachi.notes: [Izakaya · Teramachi] A two-storey izakaya under a big lantern on Teramachi: Miyazaki jidori grilled over charcoal, jidori tataki, sashimi and clay-pot rice at night, and chicken nanban or fried horse mackerel sets at lunch for about ¥900–1,500. Dinner about ¥4,000–5,000; closed Wednesdays.

chef_bio.background: A January 2022 reviewer from Miyazaki wrote that the chef trained at a restaurant in Miyazaki; reviewers call it a Miyazaki-style jidori restaurant (2021–23). An August 2023 review is titled "Relocation and Renovation". The owner loves high-school baseball — the upstairs room is hung with jerseys (August 2023) — and a February 2026 reviewer writes that the shop's name comes from the owner's baseball background. The owner writes the menu by hand each day from the day's ingredients (September 2025); an April 2025 reviewer noted more emphasis on fish lately.
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled Miyazaki jidori; jidori tataki; lunch sets.

anecdotes.text: An April 2024 diner at the counter was told by the owner that the jidori tataki is not served in the colder months, and took bone-in grilled chicken home.
At a September 2025 lunch the staff adjusted the seating height for a family's small children; the reviewer, back after a dinner days before, had the off-menu chicken nanban.
An April 2025 reviewer found the manager friendly and easy to talk to, but thought guests who dislike a homey atmosphere might find it a bit much.
At a February 2026 lunch the owner offered a refill of rice and pointed out that there was more soup.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都寺町 きゅうどう、居酒屋、中京区寺町通竹屋町上ル下御霊前町647-1、神宮丸太町駅から488m、京阪神宮丸太町駅・地下鉄市役所前駅から徒歩10分、月火木金土日・祝日 11:30〜14:00、18:00〜23:00、水曜休み、予約可、コース6,000円 (税込) から、お通し代500円 (税込)、カード・PayPay 可、36席、貸切可、加熱式たばこのみ喫煙所、子ども可、テイクアウト。口コミ (2021〜2026年、英語): 宮崎の地鶏の炭火焼き、地鶏のたたき、料理人は宮崎の店で修業 (2022年1月)、2階に野球のユニフォーム (2023年8月)、店名は店主の野球から (2026年2月)、手書きの日替わりメニュー (2025年9月)、チキン南蛮定食950円、あじフライ定食850円 (2024年3月)、かつおの漬け丼1,500円 (2026年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: A handwritten daily menu (September 2025 review); course details arranged by phone, and phone service may be Japanese only (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated February and September 2026.

kyoto_grill_stand_higashinotoin.gf_detail: Ask. Pork cutlet, fried oysters and mixed fry are breaded, the Napolitan is spaghetti, and the curry and hayashi rice are house-made sauces with no ingredient list (official menu); no gluten information.
kyoto_grill_stand_higashinotoin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every set is beef, pork, oysters or egg (official menu); no vegan dish sourced.
kyoto_grill_stand_higashinotoin.hours_raw: Official site: 11:30–13:30 and 17:30–20:00; closed Tuesdays and the 4th Wednesday; may close early when ingredients run out. Tabelog lists 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:30–21:30 (L.O. 21:00), closed Tuesdays; a November 2025 reviewer found it closing at 20:00. No reservations for seats — guests are seated in order of arrival; cash only; no takeaway (official site). Groups of four or more, guests not ordering food, and children of primary-school age or younger are not admitted (official site, original text 食事の御注文をされない方、四名様以上のグループ、小学生以下のお子様のご入店をお断りさせていただきます). Seven counter seats around the kitchen (official site). No smoking anywhere, e-cigarettes included (official site). On Higashinotoin-dori north of Shomen-dori, about 10 min walk from the JR Kyoto Stn central exit and 7 min from Exit 5 of Gojo Stn (official site); bicycles can be left in front of the shop sign (official site). Notices in English inside (October 2026 review).
kyoto_grill_stand_higashinotoin.notes: [Yoshoku · Higashinotoin] A seven-seat counter in a renovated townhouse near Higashi Honganji where the owner-chef, a Tsuji-trained former hotel chef, cooks every set alone: demi-glace hamburg, omurice, beef curry and Hinase oysters in winter, with everything from soup to ketchup made in-house. ¥1,500–4,700; cash only, no bookings.

chef_bio.background: The official site lists the career of the chef and owner, 伊藤智哉 (Tomoya Itoh): a graduate of 辻フランス料理専門学校 in Abeno, Osaka; the Western banquet kitchen and the French restaurant 「ル・パラディ」 of 株式会社伊良湖ガーデンホテル in Aichi; the Italian 「ストリーム」 and French 「フルーヴ」 of ホテルグランヴィア大阪; eighth head chef of the Osaka French restaurant 「アーゴ」 (which the site says ran for 37 years); second head chef of 「Cook＆Deli プレサンテ」; then director and chef of ﾌｰｽﾞﾊﾞﾝｸｲﾝﾀｰﾅｼｮﾅﾙ株式会社, developing sauces and deli dishes for ホテルグランヴィア京都, products for 阪急阪神百貨店, and the signature croquettes of お菜屋「わだ家」, a shop produced by 和田アキ子. The site's posts start in April 2019, when the shop appeared in the new-openings corner of the local site まいぷれ.
chef_bio.philosophy: The site calls it a shop for the Western-style dishes Japanese people love, with soups, curry, ketchup and dressings all made in-house by the owner, and invites guests to talk food with the owner across the counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Beef stew (the dinner speciality); demi-glace hamburg steak; omurice; beef curry; fried oysters in winter.

anecdotes.text: Arriving at about 19:20 on a holiday weekend in November 2025 without a booking, a diner got a seat at the U-shaped counter, where the owner cooks and serves alone, and had five juicy fried oysters with tartar sauce.
A January 2026 diner came for the winter-only fried oysters and ordered them without looking at the rest of the menu.
An October 2026 reviewer noticed a new white noren on the renovated townhouse and notices in English inside, and found two small hamburg steaks in a light, slightly sweet demi-glace.
After a visit to Shosei-en garden in September 2025, a diner had the demi-glace hamburg lunch with chestnut gelato and iced coffee, and liked the okara on the side.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (grillstand.jp): 洋食グリルスタンド、下京区東洞院通正面上ル筒金町51-2、11:30〜13:30、17:30〜20:00、火曜と第四水曜休み、カウンター席のみ7席、席の予約不可、現金のみ、テイクアウトなし、四名様以上のグループ・小学生以下のお子様はお断り、全面禁煙、スープ・カレー・ケチャップ・ドレッシングまで店主の手作り、セットはスープ・洋風おから・サラダつき、国産牛ヒレ肉ステーキ4,700円、ビーフカレーライス2,100円、デミグラスソースハンバーグ1,850円、カキフライ (岡山県日生産) 1,850円、オムライス1,600円、鉄板ナポリタン1,500円。シェフ 伊藤智哉 (Tomoya Itoh)、辻フランス料理専門学校卒、ホテルグランヴィア大阪ほか、フレンチ「アーゴ」8代目料理長。2019年4月、まいぷれの新店オープンに掲載。食べログ: 五条駅から418m、火曜休み。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 店主がひとりでカウンターを切り盛り、冬のカキフライ、英語の案内。

cultural_comfort.note: Notices in English inside (October 2026 review); counter seating with the owner; no groups of four or more and no children of primary-school age or younger (official site).

existence.note: Official site with posts dated through October 2026 and a closure notice for 24–26 November 2026; Tabelog reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_tsumugi_cafe_okazaki.gf_detail: Ask. Pancakes, spaghetti and nama-fu (wheat gluten) are on the menu (2026 reviews); no gluten information for the sweet-potato desserts.
kyoto_tsumugi_cafe_okazaki.vegan_detail: Ask. The sweet-potato desserts use dairy (salted-butter soft serve; the shop's Tabelog text), and the lunch plates have hamburg steak and cod roe; the lemon drinks use lemons pickled in honey (July 2026). Salads (two of five to choose, July 2026), kinpira and carrot râpée appear on the plates, but none is described as vegan.
kyoto_tsumugi_cafe_okazaki.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–18:00 (food L.O. 17:30), with occasional irregular closures (Tabelog). Lunch ended at 15:00 on a January 2026 visit, with an all-day menu after. No reservations; takeaway (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), transport IC, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). 20 seats at a counter, tables and sofas; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; English menu (Tabelog). Children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). In ポルトド岡崎 101 on Jingumichi, 1 min from the Jingu-michi bus stop, 5 min walk from Higashiyama Stn, near Heian Shrine and the Kyoto City Kyocera Museum of Art (Tabelog). Full within half an hour of an 11:00 opening in September 2026; a November 2026 reviewer suggests coming at opening time. Opened 18 July 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_tsumugi_cafe_okazaki.notes: [Café · Okazaki] A cat-themed café on Jingumichi by Heian Shrine and the art museums, run by an owner from Tokachi, Hokkaido: baked-sweet-potato soft serve with salted butter, sweet-potato pancakes, lemon squash, and lunch plates. Two shop cats come in on a few days a month. About ¥1,000–2,000.

chef_bio.origin: Tokachi, Hokkaido (the owner; the shop's Tabelog text)
chef_bio.background: Opened 18 July 2025 (Tabelog). The shop's own Tabelog text says the owner comes from Tokachi in Hokkaido and builds original recipes featuring local dairy products and seasonal ingredients, with homemade drinks made with lemons from Awaji Island. Two cats are on a calendar for about two working days a month (April 2026 review) and were seen at the register in June, July, August and October 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Baked sweet potato with salted-butter soft serve; sweet-potato pancakes; lemon squash.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor who had been handed a flyer at the opening finally took away the baked-sweet-potato salted-butter soft serve, and found two cats asleep by the register.
In June 2026 a guest came on hearing a cat was in unexpectedly; the staff brought the cat over with a toy.

A January 2026 reviewer found the ¥1,500 Neapolitan disappointing — thin sausage and little pepper — while a companion liked the seafood rice bowl; an April 2026 couple found the garlic tarako spaghetti hardly tasted of garlic but liked the mini soft serve.
An October 2026 reviewer noted many visitors from overseas during the Ghibli exhibition at the nearby museum; in November 2026 Ghibli music played as visitors came from the exhibition.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗の公式情報): つむぎカフェ、カフェ・スイーツ・ソフトクリーム、左京区岡崎円勝寺町140 ポルトド岡崎 101、東山駅から徒歩5分 (334m)、バス停「神宮道」から徒歩1分、毎日 11:00〜18:00 (フードL.O. 17:30)、不定休あり、予約不可、テイクアウト、カード・交通系IC・iD・QUICPay・PayPay 可、20席、車いす可、英語メニュー、子ども可、2025年7月18日オープン。店主は北海道十勝の出身、焼き芋の塩バターソフトクリーム、焼き芋のパンケーキ、淡路島のレモンのドリンク、猫のインテリア。口コミ (2026年、英語): 看板猫が月2回ほど出勤、ナポリタン1,500円、たらこスパゲッティ1,500円、抹茶ラテ900円ほど、海外からの客が多い (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); many overseas visitors (October 2026 review); friendly staff (2026 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing (official information); reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_tsumugi_cafe_okazaki.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26043335/ (35.010945, 135.782551); same building as kyoto_hourandou_heian_jingu (ポルト・ド岡崎 105, 35.010867, 135.78249), about 10 m apart; not OSM-checked by the worker; 2026-11-26

kyoto_kaisen_chirashi_oike_nijojo.gf_detail: Ask. Seafood chirashi on vinegared rice with sweet-braised shiitake and shredded egg, served with a house-blended soy sauce; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kaisen_chirashi_oike_nijojo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the menu is seafood bowls — chirashi, tuna bowls — served with miso soup (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kaisen_chirashi_oike_nijojo.hours_raw: Saturday and Sunday 11:30–14:30, until sold out; open on some public holidays — check by phone or Instagram (Tabelog). About 30 chirashi a day (September 2024; June 2026). Reservations by phone or Instagram DM (July 2025; June 2026); a booking is cancelled if the shop has not heard from you within 10 minutes (Tabelog). 10 counter seats (Tabelog); shoes off at the entrance (July 2026). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR payments; no service charge (Tabelog). No parking (Tabelog; July 2025). In the evening the space is a snack bar or lounge (July 2025; June 2026).
kyoto_kaisen_chirashi_oike_nijojo.notes: [Seafood chirashi · Oike-dori by Nijo Castle, weekend lunch only] A ten-seat counter on Oike-dori near Nijo Castle that opens only for weekend lunch, serving about 30 seafood chirashi a day: thick slices of tuna, yellowtail, sea bream and more over house vinegared rice, made by the mother of the family. Book by phone or Instagram DM; it fills fast. A snack bar uses the room at night.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers say the owner ran a popular eatery in Saiin for 40 years before moving here, and that the name comes from regulars there calling the owner “Okasan” (mother) (September 2024); that the owner has bought at the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market for over 20 years (July 2025); and that the owner ran a sushi restaurant for many years (April 2026). The shop is run by three generations of women — mother, daughter and granddaughter (September 2024) — or a mother and daughter (April 2026). The September 2024 reviewer calls the vinegared-rice recipe a closely guarded secret and the soy sauce a house blend.
chef_bio.specialty: Seafood chirashi.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 diner arrived at opening and was the first in; the counter soon filled, and some groups were turned away.
On a rainy June 2026 day, with few diners, a reviewer found the bowl almost all fatty cuts, with just-picked cucumber and bamboo shoots on the side.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: おかんの海鮮ちらし、海鮮、中京区大文字町233-8、二条城前駅3番出口から徒歩3分、JR二条駅から徒歩10分、土・日 11:30〜14:30、祝日も営業することがある (電話かInstagramで確認)、売り切れ次第終了、カード可、電子マネー・QR決済不可、サービス料・チャージ料なし、カウンター10席、貸切は20名まで、駐車場なし、予約可 (10分連絡がなければキャンセル扱い)。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 週末だけの営業で1日30食、御池通沿い、Saiinで40年人気の店をしていた店主が移ってきた、常連が店主を Okasan (母) と呼んだのが店名の由来、20年以上市場で仕入れる、長年寿司店をしていた、母・娘・孫の3代の女性で営む (2024年9月)、母と娘で営む (2026年4月)、海鮮ちらし2,500円、まぐろ、トロ、ぶり、鯛、サーモン、えび、いか、とびこ、甘く煮た椎茸と錦糸卵の酢飯、味噌汁、ガリ、漬物、トロたく丼2,000円、5食限定の鉄火丼2,000円、粕汁のおかわり、デザートはアイスかコーヒー、予約は電話かInstagramのDM、靴を脱いで上がるカウンター、夜はスナックやラウンジになる。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; shoes off at the entrance, which one July 2026 reviewer thought made it less accessible for foreign visitors. Book by phone or Instagram DM.

existence.note: Tabelog listing checked 2026-11-26 (no closure badge); reviews dated September 2024 to September 2026.

kyoto_izakaya_oike_kuromon.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, grilled fish and seared bonito alongside tempura, gyoza, kara-age, yakisoba and soba; no gluten information (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_oike_kuromon.vegan_detail: Ask. Cucumber and tofu dishes appear, but nothing is described as vegan; agedashi tofu comes in dashi, and most dishes are fish or meat (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_oike_kuromon.hours_raw: Daily 17:30–24:00; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR payments; the all-you-can-drink course is cash only (Tabelog). ¥300 appetizer per person (Tabelog). 25 seats: 8 at the counter, three tables of 4, and a second-floor loft used as a private room for 10–20; buyouts up to 20 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). No parking (Tabelog). About 5 minutes from exit 3 of Nijojo-mae station (Tabelog). Often fully booked: book ahead (June 2025).
kyoto_izakaya_oike_kuromon.notes: [Izakaya · Oike-dori near Horikawa-Oike, fish and Kyoto sake] A long, narrow, dim izakaya in a house near Horikawa-Oike, with a counter, a few tables and a loft for groups. The chef cooks alone: thick seared bonito, grilled fish, shirako with ponzu, homemade karasumi, with Kyoto sake to match; all-you-can-drink courses from ¥5,000. More for locals than tourists (August 2026). Often full: book.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a friendly master and cute staff (February 2025); the chef handling all the cooking with one part-time staff member in the hall (July 2025); and karasumi made by the owner (November 2025; August 2026). Staff welcomed a group warmly late at night (November 2022).
chef_bio.specialty: Fish; homemade karasumi.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 group that had been turned away as a walk-in came back with a booking for four; when the group left, the place was full again.
In November 2022 the appetizer of stuffed green peppers so pleased one diner that the diner began making it at home.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: しっぽり屋、居酒屋、中京区御池通黒門西入俵屋町190-1、二条城前駅3番出口から徒歩5分、毎日 17:30〜24:00、不定休、カード可 (VISA、Master、JCB、AMEX、Diners)、電子マネー・QR決済不可、飲み放題のコースは現金のみ、つきだし一人300円、25席 (カウンター8、4人掛けテーブル3)、2階のロフトは10〜20名の個室、貸切20名まで、喫煙可、駐車場なし。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 京都らしい奥に長い店、カウンターとテーブル、少し暗め、親しみやすいマスター、調理は料理人一人とホールにアルバイト一人、厚切りのかつおのたたきにからし、ぶりのたたき、刺身、さんまの塩焼き、めごちやわかさぎの天ぷら、自家製のからすみ、からすみ餅、白子ポン酢、おでん、だし巻き、餃子、生姜餃子、締めのカレー、イカ墨パスタ、飲み放題のおまかせコース5,000円 (豚足、焼き魚の盛り合わせ、手羽先の唐揚げ、かつおのたたき、焼きそば、揚げ出し豆腐、Yamagata の細いざるそば)、京都の日本酒、Fushimiの Yamamoto Honke の飲食店限定の生原酒、観光客より地元の客向け、予約が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Neighbourhood izakaya that caters more to locals than tourists (August 2026); phone bookings may be in Japanese only (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing checked 2026-11-26 (no closure badge); reviews dated November 2022 to October 2026.

kyoto_izakaya_kyoto_tower_since1905.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, dashimaki, yakitori and grilled fin alongside okonomiyaki, kushiage and yakisoba; no gluten information (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_kyoto_tower_since1905.vegan_detail: Ask. Edamame and salads appear, but nothing is described as vegan; most dishes are fish or meat (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_kyoto_tower_since1905.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 17:00–23:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog, which says hours may change). A March 2025 reviewer says it is open until 22:30. Lunch set meals were served in 2011–2016 reviews; Tabelog now lists evenings only. Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR payments (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog; 2012 and 2017 reviewers met smoking at lunch). No parking (Tabelog). In the basement of the 飯田ビル, about 270 m from Kyoto Station, near Kyoto Tower (Tabelog; reviews); the building was new and the shop modern after a 2014 renovation (January 2015; September 2016).
kyoto_izakaya_kyoto_tower_since1905.notes: [Izakaya · Kyoto Station front by Kyoto Tower, old name, modern room] A basement izakaya a few minutes from Kyoto Station, under a sign giving its founding as 1905, rebuilt as a modern, calm room in 2014: sashimi, dashimaki, yakitori, okonomiyaki and kushiage at prices reviewers call reasonable for the location. Handy before a train. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers read the founding year 1905 on the shop sign (September 2011; September 2016). A January 2015 reviewer calls the shop a relative of the nearby Iidaya inn, renovated into a modern izakaya in 2014; a September 2016 reviewer found it in the basement of a new building on the old site. Earlier reviewers describe a station-front lunch diner with daily set meals and friendly service (2011–2012).
chef_bio.specialty: Izakaya dishes; dashimaki.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 diner worked out that drinking until last call still left time for the 23:08 train toward Himeji.
In March 2026 a group stopped in on the way back from a crab trip to Miyazu and found the prices reasonable for a spot so close to the station.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 飯田屋 惣平、居酒屋、下京区塩小路通烏丸東入ル東塩小路町717-3 飯田ビル B1F、京都駅から267m、月〜土 17:00〜23:00、日曜定休、カード可 (JCB、AMEX、Diners)、電子マネー・QR決済不可、禁煙、駐車場なし、予約可。口コミ (2011〜2026年、英語): 看板に創業1905年、近くの旅館 (Iidaya Inn) の縁の店、2014年に改装してモダンな居酒屋に、新しいビルの地下1階、以前は京都駅前の昼の定食屋 (日替わり定食、焼きそば定食)、惣平鍋 (ちゃんこ風卵とじ鍋)、イカ素干し、だし巻き (Sohei dashimaki) 580円、わさび昆布450円、熱燗2合750円 (2018年10月)、刺身の盛り合わせ、鱧の天ぷら、豆腐サラダ、とんぺい焼き、焼き鳥の盛り合わせ、カマンベールのオーブン焼き、焼きそば (2023年6月)、サラダ、刺身、串の盛り合わせ、だし巻き、牛タン、赤ワイン (2025年4月)、22時30分まで (2025年3月)、枝豆、お好み焼き、鴨むね、串揚げの盛り合わせ、豚キムチ、エイヒレ (2026年3月)、駅前なのに手ごろな値段。

cultural_comfort.note: Station-front izakaya; phone bookings may be in Japanese only (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing checked 2026-11-26 (no closure badge); reviews dated 2011 to March 2026, two in 2025–2026.

kyoto_nepali_curry_kyoto_tower_annex.gf_detail: Ask. Curry with rice, most topped with fried chicken; no gluten information (own site; 2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nepali_curry_kyoto_tower_annex.vegan_detail: Ask. An eggplant and bean curry was on the menu (June 2024), but nothing is described as vegan; butter chicken and pork curries are the mainstays.
kyoto_nepali_curry_kyoto_tower_annex.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–15:00, open year-round (own site; Tabelog). Takeaway; phone ahead for a smoother pickup; also on Uber Eats (own site). Cards and e-money accepted (Tabelog; own site). Non-smoking (Tabelog). No parking (Tabelog). On the 2nd floor of the Kyoto Tower Building north annex; up the stairs or lift by the door next to Ito Ken on the ground floor (June 2024). About 40 seats (June 2024).
kyoto_nepali_curry_kyoto_tower_annex.notes: [Nepali curry · Kyoto Station front, lunch only] A lunch-only Nepali curry room upstairs in the Kyoto Tower Building north annex: butter chicken and mapo-pork curries, often as a two-curry combination topped with crisp fried chicken, at three spice levels — reviewers warn even the milder levels run hot. Usually has free seats when the station is packed. Run with the Chinese restaurant downstairs, whose dishes are also served.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog notes that the menu of the creative kitchen さいか亭 is also served; reviewers describe the curry room as run by the Chinese restaurant on the floor below (November 2021; November 2024), with ramen, braised-pork rice and dumplings on offer. Tabelog now marks さいか亭 closed; a February 2026 reviewer says the ground floor is a ramen shop under the same management. Opinions differ: one reviewer calls it authentic Nepali curry (February 2024); others found the butter chicken mild (November 2024) or the heat just chilli (February 2026). A September 2025 diner remembers the waitress’s cheerful thank-you.
chef_bio.specialty: Mapo pork and butter chicken combination curry.

anecdotes.text: A June 2024 diner ordered the eggplant and bean curry “a little spicy” and found it a real kick; next time, the regular level.
In February 2024 a diner, turned away by lines everywhere in Kyoto Station, followed the sign upstairs and took the combination at extra-hot with a draft beer.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: KUMARI NAGI (クマリ ナギ)、京都駅前の本格ネパールカレーの店、下京区東塩小路町721-1 京都タワービル北新館2F、11:30〜15:00、年中無休、カード各種可、いろいろなスパイスのコクと辛さのカレー、豚肉と鶏肉、辛さは3段階、カレーに+100円でラッシー、店内でドリンクも、持ち帰りは電話しておくとスムーズ、Uber Eatsもある。食べログ: ネパール料理・インド料理・インドカレー、毎日 11:30〜15:00、カード・電子マネー可、禁煙、駐車場なし、さいか亭 (saika-tei.com) のメニューも店内で注文できる。口コミ (2021〜2026年、英語): 下の階の中華の店が営む、ラーメンや豚肉の煮込みご飯、餃子もある、バターチキンカレー800円 (2021年11月)、980円 (2023年4月)、1,080円 (2026年2月)、唐揚げとスプラウトのせ、麻婆ポークとバターチキンのあいがけ1,200円 (2023年4月)、1,300円 (2024年2月、2025年11月)、なすと豆のカレー1,080円、ご飯の追加50円、ラッシー100円、少し辛いでもかなり辛い、約40席、昼は空いていることが多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Casual lunch room; spice level chosen when ordering.

existence.note: Own site and Tabelog listing checked 2026-11-26 (no closure badge); reviews dated November 2021 to February 2026. The sister izakaya さいか亭 is marked closed on Tabelog.

kyoto_udon_soba_marutamachi_26018796.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon and soba in a soy-seasoned bonito broth, rice bowls and set meals (2011–2026 reviews); no gluten-free option stated.
kyoto_udon_soba_marutamachi_26018796.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the noodle broth is bonito dashi (May 2022); kamaboko, chicken, egg and meat dishes too (2011–2026 reviews).
kyoto_udon_soba_marutamachi_26018796.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 11:00–19:00; closed Sunday and public holidays; hours and closed days may change. A June 2023 reviewer gives the hours as from before noon to 15:00, then 16:00–17:00, with no evening service, so check before an evening visit. Reservations taken (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; QR-code payments accepted (Tabelog). 18 seats; non-smoking; no parking (Tabelog). 10 min walk from Karasuma-Marutamachi subway station, on Marutamachi-dori west of Muromachi.
kyoto_udon_soba_marutamachi_26018796.notes: [Udon & soba · Marutamachi-Muromachi, a Showa-era tea-soba shop] An old neighbourhood noodle shop near the Imperial Palace where every soba is green-tea soba: herring soba, kitsune udon and lunch sets of noodles with kayaku rice or a small rice bowl, mostly under ¥1,000. Renovated entrance, Showa-diner feel. Closed Sunday; check the closing time.

chef_bio.background: A 2024 reviewer calls it a long-established shop facing Marutamachi-dori, with a newly renovated entrance and new interior; the shop seems to have expanded west into the older premises next door, connected inside (June 2024). An August 2018 reviewer returning after 20 years found a quaint wooden interior and a kitchen run by a man and a young proprietress; the shop was featured on KBS Kyoto's "極上の京都", aired 15 April 2014, where the dish shown was meat udon (August 2018 review). In September 2011 a reviewer counted six tables, four counter seats and two raised dining areas, and saw a waitress, an elderly woman in the kitchen and what seemed to be the owner, with tension among the staff. Reviewers describe an older, local clientele (2018, June 2024) and a classic Showa-era diner (September 2026). A May 2026 reviewer found the cold tea soba mushy and the staff "not very friendly".
chef_bio.specialty: Green-tea soba; herring soba; udon-and-rice lunch sets.

anecdotes.text: August 2018: "Here, all the soba noodles are made from tea leaves. You can choose between tea soba or udon. The most famous dish is the herring soba."
December 2025: "I ordered the service lunch set of Kitsune Udon and rice for JPY 850. Even though it was just past noon, the restaurant was quiet and calm, without being crowded."
May 2026 (in Japanese): サービスセットはキツネとじうどんと御飯、850円です。ビールを注文したら大ビンが出てきて600円でした。

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 昭月、麺類、中京区丸太町室町西入道場町5、丸太町駅から180m、地下鉄烏丸丸太町から徒歩10分、月〜土11:00〜19:00、日曜・祝日休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー不可、QRコード決済可、18席、禁煙、駐車場なし。口コミ (2011年9月〜2026年9月、多くは英語): 丸太町通の老舗のうどんとそばの店、そばはすべて茶そば、にしんそばが名物、鍋焼きも、ランチのサービスセット (きつねそばとかやくご飯680円 (2018年8月)、750円 (2024年6月)、丼とミニうどんの日替わりセット700円 (2020年9月)、きつねうどんとご飯850円 (2025年12月)、鶏南蛮うどんとご飯850円 (2026年3月))、かつおだしのつゆ (2022年5月)、KBS京都「極上の京都」で紹介 (2014年4月15日放送)、入口を改装し西隣へ広げた (2024年6月)、昭和の食堂の雰囲気 (2026年9月)。日本語の口コミ (2026年5月): 町のうどん屋さん、サービスセットはキツネとじうどんと御飯850円、ビールの大ビン600円、卵のとじ方がトロトロ。

cultural_comfort.note: A local noodle shop; set meals posted on the wall (June 2024); phone may be Japanese only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated November 2025 to September 2026.

kyoto_izakaya_rido_26015142.gf_detail: Ask: small home-style side dishes that change daily (simmered tofu, lotus root, sardines, potatoes, salad), plus yakisoba made with udon, pork kimchi and tamagoyaki (2019–2026 reviews); no gluten-free option stated.
kyoto_izakaya_rido_26015142.vegan_detail: Ask: the daily side dishes have included simmered tofu with shiitake, sweet-spicy lotus root and simmered sweet potato (2022, 2026), but also sardines, salami and octopus; no vegan option stated.
kyoto_izakaya_rido_26015142.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 18:00–01:30; closed Sunday; hours and closed days may change. Reservations taken (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR codes (Tabelog). No parking. A long-counter karaoke izakaya inside リド飲食街 (Rido Dining Street), an old alley of small bars just north of the Yodobashi Camera by Kyoto Station (2019 reviews). The restroom is shared with the other shops (October 2022). Quiet just after 18:00 and busy from about 20:00 (November 2026). 430 m from Kyoto Station.
kyoto_izakaya_rido_26015142.notes: [Izakaya · Rido Dining Street by Kyoto Station, a Showa karaoke counter] A long-counter bar in the old Rido alley north of Kyoto Station, passed from mother to daughter over some 60 years (2019 review): a ¥1,000 set of a beer and two home-style dishes, udon yakisoba, karaoke with prizes for the day's lucky score, and regulars who draw newcomers in. Cash only; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: A November 2019 reviewer writes: "The restaurant is run by a woman, who is following in the footsteps of her mother; it has been around for 60 years". The same reviewer counted 12 shops in Rido Dining Street, 8 of them run by women and all 8 with karaoke. Reviewers describe "a lovely lady who creates a warm environment" (September 2019), "an older lady … sitting gracefully at the helm" (January 2022), and an owner who was "particularly friendly", with a "charming young lady" also behind the counter later in the evening (April 2025). In October 2026 a reviewer wrote that the space "created by the owner and regulars is filled with a genuine local vibe", with no commercial atmosphere aimed at tourists. Karaoke comes with a daily "service" score: hit it and a drink is on the house (October 2022; July 2026). A September 2019 reviewer noted that talk of the alley's demolition would not be surprising.
chef_bio.specialty: The ¥1,000 horoyoi set; karaoke.

anecdotes.text: October 2022: "They offer special services based on your karaoke score, and on this occasion, scoring a final digit of '1' grants you a treat! … I was able to hit the jackpot and received an extra glass of draft beer."

October 2026: "Even the first-time guests, who might initially feel nervous, are naturally engaged in conversation at a comfortable distance, and before I knew it, I was laughing alongside the regulars next to me."
November 2026: "Here, they offer a 'Horo-yoi Set' which includes two appetizers and a draft beer for just JPY 1000, tax included!"

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 新ばし、居酒屋、下京区七条通烏丸西入東境町180、京都駅から430m、月〜土18:00〜翌1:30、日曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、駐車場なし。口コミ (2017年1月〜2026年11月、英語): リド飲食街の昭和の雰囲気の長いカウンターのカラオケ居酒屋、母のあとを継いだ女性が営み60年 (2019年11月)、Horo-yoiセット1,000円 (生ビールなどと小鉢二品)、日替わりの小鉢 (小芋といわしの煮物、豆腐としいたけの煮物とれんこん、サラミとサラダ、さつまいもの煮物ときゅうりとたこの酢の物)、うどんの焼きそば (2017年は600円)、卵焼き、豚キムチ、カラオケの点数でサービス、トイレは共用 (2022年10月)、常連と初めての客が打ち解ける (2026年10月)、20時ごろから混む (2026年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: A counter of regulars and karaoke; cash only; phone may be Japanese only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated April 2025 to November 2026.

kyoto_mon_gallery_wine_bar.gf_detail: Ask: homemade bread is the signature, and pizza, pasta, panini and gnocchi are served (2023–2026 reviews); there are also meat, duck, burrata and vegetable dishes; no gluten-free option stated.
kyoto_mon_gallery_wine_bar.vegan_detail: Ask: vegetable dishes such as hummus, tomato and eggplant appear on the changing menu (September–October 2026), alongside meat, fish and cheese; no vegan option stated.
kyoto_mon_gallery_wine_bar.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Thu–Sun 18:00–02:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday. Reservations taken (Tabelog); a September 2025 visitor found it full but one seat the night before a holiday. Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and QR payments; no e-money (Tabelog). 6 seats (Tabelog; "six counter seats", November 2026). Non-smoking. Opened 21 January 2023 (Tabelog). The way in is up stairs to the left of the building to a first-floor door (February 2025 reviews). A February 2025 reviewer reports a one-drink policy with no non-alcoholic drinks besides small 30 ml teas. 5 min from Nijojo-mae, 10 min from Hankyu Omiya, on the Sanjo shopping street.
kyoto_mon_gallery_wine_bar.notes: [Wine bar · Sanjo shopping street near Nijo Castle, a gallery wine bar] A six-seat natural-wine counter inside a concrete-and-wood gallery and tableware shop run by a Kyoto design studio. A sommelier cooks seasonal small plates and pasta to pair with the wines; the homemade bread is the draw. One person runs it, so it can be slow. Open to 2:00; closed Tue–Wed.

chef_bio.background: MON株式会社 (MON Inc.), a Kyoto branding and design studio formerly called エコノシスデザイン (renamed February 2026), describes the shop as the gallery and wine bar it operates, with an online shop and an office in Naha (official site). Reviewers write that "the sommelier also handles the food" (February 2023) and that "the owner is a sommelier who has gained experience as a service professional" and "has also studied cooking in depth" (November 2026). One person runs the place: "the kitchen operates with just one person, the service was a bit slow" (September 2025); "the owner was very kind and managed everything" alone for a party of eight (December 2025); "only one staff member working … a bit of a hectic impression" (January 2026). A February 2025 reviewer waited about 30 minutes for the first dish, never received the promised water, and found it "not very accommodating for those who don't drink". Half of the large space sells tableware (February 2025); the interior has a fireplace (February 2025) and a concrete theme (November 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Natural wine pairings; homemade bread.

anecdotes.text: February 2023: "The sommelier also handles the food, and the pairings with natural wines are truly remarkable."
February 2025: "The bar has a one-drink policy, and they don't offer non-alcoholic options. They have tea, but only in small 30ml servings."

September 2025: "Since the kitchen operates with just one person, the service was a bit slow, but waiting patiently wasn't a bad experience. I appreciated the thoughtful gesture of being served complimentary bread as an appetizer."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: MON株式会社 (2026年2月にエコノシスデザインから社名変更)、ブランディングを軸とした京都のデザイン事務所、MONが運営するギャラリー・ワインバー、オンラインショップ、京都オフィスは中京区上一文字町285 MONビルディング、沖縄オフィスは那覇市。食べログ: MON GALLERY AND WINE BAR、ワインバー、中京区上一文字町285 MON ビルディング、二条城前から徒歩5分、月・木〜日18:00〜翌2:00、火・水休み、予約可、カード・QR可、電子マネー不可、6席、禁煙、2023年1月21日オープン。口コミ (2023年2月〜2026年11月、英語): ギャラリーと器の店を兼ねたワインバー、ソムリエが料理も、自然派ワイン、自家製パン、鴨と洋梨、ブッラータ、ピザ、カルボナーラ、ニョッキ、一人で切り盛りで提供が遅いことも、ワンドリンク制でノンアルコールはほぼなし (2025年2月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Six seats; the sommelier explains the wines (January 2026); one-drink policy (February 2025).

existence.note: Operator site lists the wine bar; Tabelog reviews dated February 2025 to November 2026.

kyoto_fugu_kani_hamo_26036172.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: courses include fugu kara-age, crab and hamo tempura, ponzu and soy-based sauces (Tabelog courses; 2026 reviews); no gluten-free option stated.
kyoto_fugu_kani_hamo_26036172.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fugu, crab and hamo restaurant; every course is built on seafood (Tabelog courses; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_fugu_kani_hamo_26036172.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00) and 16:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); open year-round. Reservations online or by phone (Tabelog). Dinner service charge ¥400 per person, à la carte or course (Tabelog). Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR payments; no e-money (Tabelog). 99 seats with private rooms for 2 to 30 and a tatami room for up to 28 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; ashtray on the 2F balcony. Children welcome, with a kids' menu (Tabelog). Opened 22 June 2021 (Tabelog). On the 2nd floor of ブライトン京都駅前, 2 min from the subway Kyoto Station, 5 min from JR Kyoto Station.
kyoto_fugu_kani_hamo_26036172.notes: [Fugu & crab · Kyoto Station, private rooms] A large fugu, crab and hamo restaurant by Kyoto Tower, almost all private rooms: fugu courses of sashimi, kara-age, grilled fugu and hot pot from ¥7,200, crab lunches, summer hamo, and fugu sashimi à la carte. Open daily, lunch and dinner; families and groups welcome. Fast-paced service.

roles: Operator: 株式会社輝樹 (Tabelog invoice registration; NTA registry)
chef_bio.background: The Tabelog invoice number T8120101063281 is registered to 株式会社輝樹 of Habikino, Osaka (NTA registry); no other restaurant of the company was found. Live fugu swim in a tank outside the entrance (March and November 2026). Reviewers praise the private rooms (February, March, May, September 2026) and staff who were "incredibly accommodating towards the kids" with a large group (June 2026). Several mention speed: "the pace at which the dishes are served is impressively fast" (March 2026); a solo diner in October 2026 had the kara-age and hot pot "all at once, like a storm", 30 minutes after entering, and was told bluntly to eat the kara-age while hot; a November 2026 group found the service "a bit slow". In February 2026 the hot pot was not offered at a lunch because of flu and COVID-19 outbreaks (one review). Reviewers rate the fugu above the crab (May 2026) and found the crab sushi bland (February 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Fugu courses; grilled crab; summer hamo.

anecdotes.text: March 2026: "I wanted my university student son, who had never tried fugu before, to experience the taste of adulthood in Kyoto before leaving the city. … Thank you for taking our photos."

July 2026: "Once the skin was nicely charred, I flipped it over and quickly grilled it. I enjoyed it with a sweet salt that enhanced its flavor, a ponzu sauce that balanced the acidity and soy sauce, and a refreshing touch of lemon!"
November 2026: "The hire-zake (sake with fugu fin) was made by soaking the fin in heated sake, then igniting it for a brief moment to enhance the aroma."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ公式: ふぐ・かに・はも 輝月、ふぐ・かに・居酒屋、下京区東塩小路町711-8 ブライトン京都駅前 2F、地下鉄京都駅から徒歩2分、JR京都駅から徒歩5分、毎日11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:00)、16:00〜22:30 (L.O.22:00)、年中無休、ディナーはサービス料ひとり400円、カード・QR可、電子マネー不可、99席、個室2〜30名、座敷は最大28名、禁煙 (2Fバルコニーに灰皿)、子ども可・キッズメニュー、2021年6月22日オープン、ふぐコースA・B 7,200円、ふぐフルコース8,900円、活ふぐと熟成ふぐ、ひれ酒、飲み放題は2,200円追加。国税庁: 登録番号T8120101063281は株式会社輝樹 (大阪府羽曳野市)。口コミ (2026年2月〜11月、英語): 焼きがにのランチコース5,800円、ふぐフルコースランチ7品6,300円、てっさ1,300円、夏の活はもの焼きコース、個室、子ども連れに親切、料理の出るのが速い、入口の水槽に活ふぐ。

kyoto_mannam_rido.gf_detail: Ask. Food comes as the owner’s choice of small dishes — sashimi, grilled fish, stir-fried lotus root, fugu skin with ponzu — with soy sauce and ponzu on the side; no gluten information (2019–2026 reviews).
kyoto_mannam_rido.vegan_detail: Ask. The set appetiser is usually fish or meat (sashimi, hamo, yakitori, fugu skin); persimmon wrapped in shiso leaves (October 2026) and stir-fried lotus root are the only plant dishes reviewers mention.
kyoto_mannam_rido.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 18:00–1:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). A counter of about six seats (December 2025 review); private hire possible; no parking (Tabelog). In the Showa-era Rido dining alley off Shichijo-dori, about 5 min walk from JR Kyoto Station (2021–2026 reviews). Karaoke: unlimited singing ¥1,000 (November 2022 review).
kyoto_mannam_rido.notes: [Izakaya · Rido alley by Kyoto Stn, a Korean-born owner’s karaoke counter] A six-seat counter in the Showa-era Rido alley, run by a friendly owner from Korea (about fifteen years in January 2022): the owner picks the small dishes — fresh sashimi, hamo, fugu skin with ponzu — with ginseng soju and karaoke. Lively and often full. Cash only; 18:00–1:00, closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a small counter in the Rido dining alley near Kyoto Station, run by one owner. In November 2019 the owner told a diner of 14 years at the shop while still feeling like “a newcomer”; in January 2022 the owner, from Korea, spoke of about 15 years here, a love of Japan and a resolve to keep going in the alley, and the diner noted that the name means “encounter” in Korean. A May 2026 visitor described a karaoke bar run by a friendly mama from Korea, who offered some rare delicacies on the house. Reviewers call the owner friendly, kind and calm (2021–2026), and the room a mix of generations, from those near retirement to young workers (December 2025). A November 2022 diner thought it not the best first stop of a bar crawl, and a December 2025 diner found it more about the mood than the food and drink. Karaoke runs most nights (2022–2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: The owner’s choice of small dishes; ginseng liquor; karaoke.

anecdotes.text: A January 2022 diner, catching the last express home, was asked “Is it okay if I just choose for you?” and was served fatty tuna, boiled eel and sautéed lotus root.
In November 2026 the eighth stop of one diner’s night was packed, with one seat left, and everyone at the counter taking turns at karaoke.
A May 2026 visitor heard from a regular that the Rido dining area dates from before the war.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋、下京区東境町180、京都駅から430m、月〜土 18:00〜翌1:00、日曜定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、貸切可、駐車場なし。口コミ (2019年11月〜2026年11月、英語): リド飲食街の小さなカウンター、6席ほど、韓国出身の店主が1人で営む、2022年1月に約15年、店名は韓国語で「出会い」の意味、注文なしで店主のおまかせの料理が出る、お通し600円、ドリンク500円、はも、中トロ、焼き鳥、れんこんの炒め物、まぐろと鯛の刺身、ししゃも、松茸のお吸い物、flatfish の焼き魚、ふぐ皮、チャンジャ、大葉で巻いた柿、ふぐ皮ポン酢、高麗人参の焼酎、レモンサワー、カラオケ (歌い放題1,000円、2022年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: No menu to read: the owner chooses the dishes; cash only. The owner is from Korea.

kyoto_nagomiya_gojo.gf_detail: Ask. Knife-cut noodles, tantanmen and fried rice sets are wheat or soy-seasoned; the hot pots’ broths and spices are not described (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nagomiya_gojo.vegan_detail: Ask. The menu centres on lamb, beef, fish and duck blood; no vegetable dish is described apart from a vegetable-topped noodle set (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nagomiya_gojo.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–14:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closing days not fixed (Tabelog). The operator’s site says open 365 days a year (三多国際, page dated as of 2019). Reservations accepted; groups accepted (Tabelog; operator’s site). No cards; e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). Order by touch panel, mostly in Japanese; water, tableware and soft drinks are self-service, with drinks taken from the fridge (February 2026 review). No private hire; no parking (Tabelog). On Gojo-dori west of Inokuma, near Tambaguchi and Gojo stations (operator’s site).
kyoto_nagomiya_gojo.notes: [Chinese · Gojo-Inokuma, hot pots and knife-cut noodles] A Chinese restaurant where Chinese diners come for the hot pots: numbing water-boiled fish with duck blood, spicy bone-in lamb, lamb skewers and Sichuan offal salad, with knife-cut noodle sets at lunch. Touch-panel ordering, self-service drinks. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, the operator and reviewers: run by 三多国際株式会社 (founded October 2013), which also runs 三多屋 in Kitahama, Osaka and 萬吉 in Fushimi, Kyoto — three shops as of 2019 (operator’s site). Reviewers from 2022 to 2026 describe authentic Chinese food and many Chinese customers; a February 2026 diner found the staff fluent in Japanese, kind and helpful, and watched the apparent manager chatting with Chinese guests, and an October 2026 diner who had lived in China for about ten years came for dishes rarely found in Japan. A January 2022 diner found the tantanmen broth bland and the fried rice tasting of chemical seasoning, and did not plan to return.
chef_bio.specialty: Chinese hot pots; knife-cut noodles.

anecdotes.text: A February 2024 diner asked the staff for help choosing and was served the spicy lamb hot pot, and sneezed and laughed through its mysterious spices.
In February 2026 a solo diner skipped the hot pot as too big for one and had 夫妻肺片 with a small bottle of 56° sorghum baijiu, and was advised to drink plenty of water with it.
An October 2026 diner who had lived in China for about ten years found water-boiled fish with duck blood and lamb spine.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 中華料理・刀削麺、下京区柿本町592-5、丹波口駅から713m、毎日 11:00〜14:00 (L.O.14:00)、17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、不定休、予約可、カード不可、電子マネー・QR 可、貸切不可、駐車場なし。運営会社 三多国際株式会社のサイト: 和家 (なごみや)、五条通猪熊西入柿本町592-5、丹波口駅・五条駅からすぐ、年中無休、団体可、ほかに三多屋 (大阪・北浜) と萬吉 (伏見)、2013年10月創業、2019年現在3店舗。口コミ (2022年1月〜2026年10月、英語): 刀削麺と担々麺とチャーハンのAセット780円 (税込、2022年1月)、野菜たっぷりのあんかけの焼きそば、羊肉の串焼き、焼いた魚の鍋、辛い鍋、水煮肉片、鶏の土鍋煮、酸っぱい漬け菜と魚の鍋、骨付き羊肉の辛い鍋とパクチー、夫妻肺片1,000円、56度のコーリャンの白酒の小瓶、紹興酒、鴨の血と湯葉と春雨の水煮魚、羊の背骨の肉、スパイスの串焼き、タッチパネルで注文、飲み物は冷蔵庫からセルフ、中国のお客さんが多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Touch-panel menu mostly in Japanese; staff speak Japanese and are helpful (February 2026).

kyoto_kenya_community_house.gf_detail: Ask. Food is mostly toast, pilaf, rice balls and lunch boxes; no gluten information (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kenya_community_house.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee, iced tea and orange juice are on the menu; butter toast, milk tea, café au lait and floats are dairy, and no vegan food is described (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kenya_community_house.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 10:00–17:00; closed Monday (the next weekday when Monday is a public holiday) and 28 December–4 January (Tabelog). No QR payment (Tabelog). Order and pay at the counter, take a number and collect when called (April 2024 review). 90 seats, non-smoking (Tabelog): counter seats at the window over the garden, tables and sofas (2022–2024 reviews), and a terrace outside the entrance (May 2025). On the first floor of the Kyoto International Community House (京都市国際交流会館), 6 min walk from Keage Stn on the Tozai line (Tabelog). Opened 8 October 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kenya_community_house.notes: [Café · Keage, a quiet break near Nanzen-ji] A roomy coffee shop in the lobby of the Kyoto International Community House, near Nanzen-ji and Murin-an: coffee, thick butter toast, pilaf and floats, with window counter seats over the garden. Calm even when nearby restaurants have queues. 10:00–17:00; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, the café’s site and reviewers: opened in October 2021 in the Kyoto International Community House, under a coffee brand the site says has been loved in Kyoto for more than 45 years. Reviewers liken the room to a hotel lobby (2022–2024) and find it calm even in the busy autumn-leaf season, when nearby restaurants had queues (November 2022). It doubles as a lounge for the hall’s visitors (March 2023): reviewers mention many people from other countries, exchange students, people studying or learning Japanese, and locals (2024–2026). A March 2023 diner found the café au lait average, and an April 2024 diner was disappointed by the disposable cups.
chef_bio.specialty: Coffee.

anecdotes.text: A November 2022 visitor with little time before an event had the ¥320 butter toast — three thick slices.
On a hot August 2024 Sunday after the Okazaki Park area, a diner cooled off with a shikuwasa soda float in a room so large it felt almost empty.
A November 2025 visitor found the garden open to the public for free in the autumn-leaf season.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、左京区粟田口鳥居町2-1 1F、蹴上駅から徒歩6分、火〜日 10:00〜17:00、月曜定休 (祝日の場合は翌平日)、年末年始 (12月28日〜1月4日) 休み、QR 不可、90席、禁煙、2021年10月8日開店。公式サイト: ケニア 京都市国際交流会館店、京都で45年以上愛され続けている自慢のコーヒー。口コミ (2022年11月〜2026年11月、英語): 京都市国際交流会館のロビーのカフェ、窓際のカウンターから庭が見える、コーヒー400円から、バタートースト320円、おにぎり550円、ピラフ、日替わりの弁当、カフェオレ、ロイヤルミルクティー、シークヮーサーのソーダフロート580円、シーフードピラフとアイスコーヒーで1,200円、オレンジジュース490円、アイスをのせたシナモントースト、カウンターで注文と会計、番号札、使い捨てのカップ、海外からの人や留学生も多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; the hall serves international visitors, and many are around (2024–2026 reviews).

kyoto_nonki_genon_ekimae.gf_detail: Ask. Gelato is served with a wafer; lunch plates are breaded cutlets, chicken nanban and hamburg steak with bread or rice; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nonki_genon_ekimae.vegan_detail: Ask. Most gelato is milk-based (Kyoto milk), and mango, peach-almond and coconut flavours are not described further; lunches are meat with a salad bar (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nonki_genon_ekimae.hours_raw: Tabelog: Monday–Saturday (and the days before and after public holidays) breakfast 6:30–10:00, café 11:30–16:00, dinner 18:00–22:00; closed Sunday and public holidays; dinner service ended on 30 December 2025, private bookings still taken. The shop’s own site differs: breakfast 6:30–10:00 and café 11:00–16:00 every day, bistro 17:00–22:00 closed Monday (the next day when Monday is a holiday); dinner is not stored here, and Sunday is left out while the two sources disagree. Weekday lunch with salad bar from ¥1,000 (Tabelog; February 2026 review: weekdays only); gelato also on Saturdays (July 2026 review). The breakfast is the hotel’s buffet, ¥2,000 for adults booked ahead (August 2025 review). Reservations accepted; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), iD and QR (PayPay, d Barai, au PAY) (Tabelog). 40 seats; non-smoking; private hire for 20–50; take-out; English menu; wheelchair access; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). On the first floor of APA Hotel Kyoto Station East, 3 min walk from Kyoto Station (Tabelog). Opened 1 June 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_nonki_genon_ekimae.notes: [Gelato and lunch · Kyoto Stn, from Gion’s のんき亭] A quiet hotel-floor gelato shop and café a few minutes from the station: two neat scoops of Kyoto-milk gelato (matcha, hojicha, strawberry milk) for ¥550, and weekday ¥1,000 lunches with a salad bar. Dinner ended in December 2025. Cards and QR accepted.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop’s site, Tabelog and reviewers: ひとさら料理 のんき and its gelato brand genon belong to Gion のんき亭 (the site links both shops under ©のんき亭; kyoto_nonki_tei_gion in data), with the gelato made in a workshop inside the shop (official site). It opened in June 2023 on the first floor of APA Hotel Kyoto Station East and serves as the hotel’s breakfast venue; an August 2025 diner quoted the hotel’s website saying the buffet is prepared by the chef of Gion のんき亭. Reviewers find it quiet and uncrowded next to the station (2024–2026) and the young staff friendly (March 2024; July 2026). A July 2025 hotel guest found the breakfast an average business-hotel buffet, and a July 2026 diner found the gelato sweet with the milk scent muddled, wishing it were fresher.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto gelato; weekday lunch with salad bar.

anecdotes.text: An August 2024 guest, waiting out a typhoon before check-in, found the hotel lobby full and took premium milk and matcha gelato here instead, topped with a heart-shaped wafer.
A May 2026 visitor, on the way back from painting a fan at a nearby fan shop, was surprised by two perfectly round scoops of the same size.
A diner came back four times in 2026 for the ¥1,000–1,200 lunches with the salad bar, calling it the best place for affordable salad near Kyoto Station.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・ジェラート、下京区東塩小路町552-1 アパホテル京都駅東 1F、京都駅から357m、月〜土・祝前日・祝後日 6:30〜10:00、11:30〜16:00、18:00〜22:00、日曜・祝日休み、2025年12月30日でディナー営業を終了 (貸切の予約は受付)、予約可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners)・電子マネー (iD)・QR (PayPay・d払い・au PAY) 可、40席、禁煙、20〜50名で貸切可、テイクアウト可、英語メニュー、2023年6月1日開店。公式サイト: ひとさら料理 のんき (アパホテル京都駅東 内1階)、BREAK FAST 6:30〜10:00、CAFE 11:00〜16:00、BISTRO 17:00〜22:00 (月曜休み)、店内の工房で作る京ジェラート genon、祇園のんき亭。口コミ (2024年3月〜2026年10月、英語): ジェラートのダブル550円、トリプル650円、プレミアムミルク、抹茶、ほうじ茶、黒糖きなこ、ココナッツ、マンゴー、いちごミルク、ピーチアーモンド、着色料・香料を使わない、平日のランチはサラダバー付き1,000円 (生姜焼き、煮込みハンバーグ、チキン南蛮)、ロースかつとチーズのミルフィーユかつ1,200円、ホテルの朝食ビュッフェ、飲み放題付きコース3,980円。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); order gelato at the counter by the entrance; cards and QR accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing fetched 2026-11-26 (dinner ended 30 December 2025; no closure notice); reviews July and October 2026; official site live.

kyoto_ogawa_shoyaku_cafe.gf_detail: GF — ask: no gluten-free claim on the official site or Tabelog. The teas are herbal blends, but the menu includes a soup plate served with bread, Handa somen (wheat, summer 2026), a burdock brownie, granola, tiramisu and stollen; the soup curry, warabi mochi and dashimaki are not described for gluten (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_ogawa_shoyaku_cafe.vegan_detail: Vegan — ask: no vegan claim. The soup curry has chicken in the broth (June 2026) and the dashimaki set is eaten with chicken dashi (official site; September and October 2026); the teas are herbal, and brown-sugar warabi mochi with corn, azuki and matcha powders is on the menu, but its ingredients are not stated (official site; September 2026).
kyoto_ogawa_shoyaku_cafe.hours_raw: Every day 10:00–17:00, last order 16:30; meals (soup curry, soup plate, dashimaki set, tuna bowl) 10:00–15:00 (official café page). Tabelog gives every day 10:00–17:00 (L.O. 16:30) with closing days not fixed — check Google Maps. No reservations (Tabelog; a July 2026 diner came at 11:30 because booking was not possible). 38 seats at 2- and 4-person tables; private hire possible (Tabelog). Cards (JCB), e-money and QR accepted; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children and strollers welcome; no parking — bicycles only out front, coin parking nearby (Tabelog; October 2026). Multilingual menu: English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese, Korean (Tabelog). First floor of the 京都小川生薬 building; the restaurant kyoto_ogawa_shoyaku_restaurant is upstairs. Opened 6 April 2024 (Tabelog). 2 minutes from Exit 2 of Nijojo-mae Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_ogawa_shoyaku_cafe.notes: [Café · Nijo Castle, herbal teas] The first-floor café of the 京都小川生薬 building near Nijo Castle, run by an herbal-medicine house that has worked with medicinal herbs for nearly a hundred years: about ten health teas, hot or iced and free-flowing, paired with warabi mochi, gelato and tiramisu, and until 15:00 a soup curry of 100 herbs or a dashimaki set (¥1,480). Calm modern Japanese room with a garden; no reservations. Teas sold to take home.

roles: Run by the herbal-medicine maker 小川生薬 (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the café pairs health teas made from 小川生薬’s high-grade herbal ingredients with sweets, aiming at an easy-drinking taste that overturns the image of herbal medicine as bitter, and draws on nearly a hundred years of working with herbal medicine. The building also holds the second-floor restaurant (kyoto_ogawa_shoyaku_restaurant) and a third-floor villa for one group. Opened 6 April 2024 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe indirect lighting and a garden (June 2026) and a calm space like a Kyoto townhouse (July 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: A nature-inspired casual café to soothe mind and body (official site: ココロとカラダを癒す自然派カジュアルカフェ).
chef_bio.specialty: Herbal tea and sweets pairings; soup curry of 100 medicinal herbs.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 visitor who ordered only a ginger lemon tea was served dokudami nuts with it and given yogurt with granola on the house.
A July 2026 diner noted that tea refills are requested with a button under the table.
A September 2026 neighbour ordered warabi mochi and drank from the self-serve choice of ten teas, likening it to a healthy afternoon tea.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都小川生薬 1F カフェスペース、お茶菓子と健康茶のペアリングを味わえる親しみやすい自然派カジュアルカフェ、小川生薬ならではの高品質な生薬を用いた健康茶、「苦そう」というイメージを覆す飲みやすい味わい、100年近く生薬を見続けてきた。10:00〜17:00 (L.O.16:30)、食事は10:00〜15:00。メニュー (税込): 5種の茶菓めぐり1,800円、お茶とジェラートセット780円、ミニパフェ＆抹茶ラテ1,300円、森のわらび餅1,200円、ルイボスティラミス1,200円、単品380円〜、100種類生薬が入った薬膳スープカレー1,480円、養生スーププレート1,280円、割ってとろ〜り。黄身だし巻き御膳1,480円、2種の漬けマグロ丼セット1,600円。お知らせ (2026年11月17日): カフェで贅沢シュトーレン1,000円。食べログ: 飲 京都小川生薬 Cafe、カフェ・スイーツ・スープカレー、中京区油小路通押小路上ル二条油小路町272、二条城前駅2番出口から徒歩2分、毎日10:00〜17:00、定休日は不定、予約不可、38席、カード (JCB)・電子マネー・QR可、禁煙、車椅子可、子ども可、多言語メニュー、2024年4月6日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 健康茶10種が飲み放題、生薬のスープカレー、黄身のだし巻き御膳、夏の半田そうめん、茶葉やグラノーラを買って帰れる。

cultural_comfort.note: English website and a menu in English, Chinese and Korean (official site; Tabelog). Tabelog warns phone service may be Japanese only. Self-serve teas; no reservations.

existence.note: Official site (café page, news of 17 November 2026); Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_ryoriya_en.gf_detail: GF — ask: the shop’s Tabelog page lists gluten-free, vegan, vegetarian and kosher options, but says nothing on how gluten is handled; courses have included tempura, fried dishes, crab noodles and dashi dishes (2024–26 reviews). Ask when booking.
kyoto_ryoriya_en.vegan_detail: Vegan — ask: the shop’s own Tabelog text says it created a vegan ramen with a kombu broth for vegetarian and vegan guests, and its page lists vegan options; the courses themselves are built on fish, dashi and meat (2024–26 reviews). Ask when booking.
kyoto_ryoriya_en.hours_raw: Dinner 18:30–21:30, closed Wednesday; breakfast 8:00–10:00 on Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays and holidays (Tabelog; the Michelin Guide page gives the same dinner hours). Reservations only; 7 or more by phone (Tabelog); online booking linked from the Michelin Guide page. A May 2026 reviewer wrote that weekday lunch ended that month and that from June 2026 lunch would be served on Sundays only (times not given). The shop holds a few à la carte days a month (Tabelog). 6 counter seats; groups of 4 or more can take the whole counter; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Cards (Visa, Mastercard, JCB); no e-money or QR; no service charge; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; English menu; children by prior phone call; coin parking nearby (Tabelog). Opened 20 June 2024 (Tabelog). 5 minutes from Omiya, Shijo Omiya and Nijojo-mae stations (Tabelog).
kyoto_ryoriya_en.notes: [Japanese · Sanjo Inokuma, vegetable-led counter] A six-seat pine counter behind a large enso-circle noren, opened in 2024 by a young chef and run by a young couple: Japanese courses built on morning-picked vegetables, well-water dashi and generous clay-pot rice, with a weekend breakfast course. Dinner about ¥20,000–30,000 (reviews). Reservations only; closed Wednesday. Listed in the Michelin Guide.

chef_bio.background: Opened on 20 June 2024 (Tabelog). The Michelin Guide page says the name EN means “circle” or “connection”, that the restaurant believes cooking reflects the person, and that some vegetables are grown with farmers in Kamigamo and by the Shugakuin Imperial Villa and picked in the morning. Reviewers describe a young owner-chef who trained at well-known restaurants and opened the shop in the chef’s twenties (August 2024, February 2025), and a restaurant run by a young couple (February 2026), the owner and the proprietress both friendly and chatty (August 2024, January 2025, June 2025, February 2026). The chef visits farmers to choose vegetables (May 2026). A December 2024 reviewer explains the pine counter, bamboo flooring and plum chopstick rests as pine, bamboo and plum for good fortune.
chef_bio.philosophy: Cooking reflects the person (Michelin Guide). The shop’s own text: everything starts at sourcing, and it uses vegetable trimmings and fish scraps for stocks to cut food waste (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Vegetable-led courses; clay-pot rice; warabi mochi made at the counter.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner, back after a year, was welcomed by the owner waiting outside in the cold, and left the drinks to the owner while chatting over sake at the end.
A May 2026 diner got the house warabi mochi instead of the usual ice cream because a guest who had ordered it cancelled, and watched it kneaded and chilled at the counter.
A February 2025 first-timer found the meal moved at the owner’s pace, and two February 2026 regulars praised the vegetables but wished for more fish.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: ミシュランガイド: りょうりや〇／Ryoriya EN、日本料理、中京区三条猪熊町635-1、店先の大きな円相の暖簾が印象的、朝採れ野菜の瑞々しさを届けてくれる、上賀茂や修学院離宮の近くの農家と野菜を育てる、18:30〜21:30、水曜休み。食べログ: りょうりや○ (リョウリヤエン)、日本料理、完全予約制 (7名以上は電話)、18:30〜21:30、水曜休み、金・土・日・祝は朝食8:00〜10:00、6席、4名以上で貸切、最大20名、カード可、サービス料なし、禁煙、車椅子可、英語メニュー、2024年6月20日オープン。店の紹介: 京野菜は生産者から直接、魚は漁の状況も確認、出汁の水は自家の井戸水、調味料まで自分で確かめる、月に数回のアラカルトの日、鯛のあらと昆布の塩ラーメン、ヴィーガンのお客様のための昆布だしのヴィーガンラーメン。口コミ (2024年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 若いご夫婦が営む、店主と女将さんが気さく、松のカウンター、朝食の御膳、土鍋ご飯、自家製からすみ、わらび餅、10月の松茸づくし。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog) and online booking via the Michelin Guide page; Tabelog warns phone service may be Japanese only. No evidence of spoken English.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (official information) and Michelin Guide page; reviews dated through October 2026.
