kyoto_rakugu_restaurant.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: lu rou fan braised with soy sauce and handmade wheat-skin dumplings with soy-sauce dips (2026 reviews).
kyoto_rakugu_restaurant.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the menu is braised pork belly over rice and meat-filled dumplings (2026 reviews).
kyoto_rakugu_restaurant.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–20:30; closed Wednesday; hours may change. Payment: Tabelog says cards are accepted (no e-money or QR), but an October 2026 reviewer wrote that only cash is accepted — bring cash. Non-smoking; no private rooms; no parking (Tabelog). On the second floor of the パレステート日生熊野 building across from Kumano Shrine: up the stairs, at the end of the hall (August 2026). Opened May 2025 (owner, as told to an August 2026 reviewer). About 8 minutes from Jingu-Marutamachi Station.
kyoto_rakugu_restaurant.notes: [Taiwanese · Kumano Shrine, lu rou fan] A small, quiet lu rou fan shop at the end of a hallway in a retro building across from Kumano Shrine, run by a cheerful couple from China: tender braised pork belly over rice from ¥880 with soup, and handmade boiled dumplings from ¥400 for six. Classical music, chocolate on the way out. Closed Wednesday; bring cash.

chef_bio.background: Run by a husband-and-wife couple (March, May, August, October 2026 reviews). An August 2026 reviewer was told that the husband worked in the media industry in China before turning to winemaking, and opened the restaurant in a much-loved Kyoto in May 2025; the husband explained that lu rou fan is Taiwanese rather than Chinese, and the wife mentioned a hope of making lu rou fan with wine one day. The room is quiet and dimly lit with classical music (September 2025, August and October 2026). An October 2026 reviewer notes that Japanese is not widely spoken, but the couple is very welcoming.
chef_bio.specialty: Taiwanese lu rou fan; handmade boiled dumplings.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner came alone on a Friday, returned for Sunday lunch with the diner’s wife, and was given two bowls, a spoon and soup for both to share one regular lu rou fan.
The same October 2026 diner went back after leaving to point out a mistake on the bill, and said it was put right smoothly.
A September 2025 reviewer who had known the building for over 20 years had no idea it held so many restaurants on its semi-basement and middle floors.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 樂遇レストラン、台湾料理、左京区聖護院山王町43-2 パレステート日生熊野、11:30〜15:00・17:00〜20:30、水曜休み、カード可・電子マネーとQR不可、禁煙、駐車場なし。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): 熊野神社の向かいのレトロなビルの2階、階段を上がった廊下の奥、中国出身のご夫婦が営む、台湾の魯肉飯は普通1,080円 (スープ付き)・小880円・大は400円増し、手作りの水餃子6個400円・12個800円・20個1,200円、八角と五香粉の豚バラ、鹿児島の農場の豚、創業140年を超える京都の醤油、帰りにチョコレート、クラシック音楽、2025年5月開店、2026年10月の口コミでは現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Owners from China; an October 2026 reviewer says Japanese is not widely spoken, but the menu is short (lu rou fan in three sizes and dumplings) and easy to point at. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_tender_coffee_wonder_waffle.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a waffle café; the food is waffles, doria and gratin (2022–26 reviews). No gluten-free claim.
kyoto_tender_coffee_wonder_waffle.vegan_detail: Not vegan: waffles come with cream, butter or ice cream, and the savoury dishes use cheese, bacon, sausage or meat sauce (2022–24 reviews). No vegan claim.
kyoto_tender_coffee_wonder_waffle.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday, plus irregular days (shop’s Instagram bio; Tabelog the same). An October 2022 reviewer noted that Instagram often announced an 11:30 opening while the signs said 11:00. Tabelog says no reservations, while a February 2022 reviewer wrote that bookings could be made by Instagram DM or phone. Cash only (Tabelog; October 2022, June 2024). Counter seating, small and cozy; non-smoking; no parking (Tabelog). Second floor of the パレステート日生熊野 building, directly across from Kumano Shrine, with a sign on the street (February 2022, January 2026). About 8 minutes from Jingu-Marutamachi Station (August 2026).
kyoto_tender_coffee_wonder_waffle.notes: [Café · Kumano Shrine, waffles] A small second-floor counter café looking straight across at Kumano Shrine, cozy with teddy bears, books and handmade goods: freshly baked thin, crisp waffles from simple to Mont Blanc (about ¥750), doria and gratin sets with a half waffle (¥1,300 in 2024), and coffee. Cash only; closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in February and October 2022 describe a woman owner running the café alone, so service can take a while when busy. The room has teddy bears and books (February 2022), a country style with handmade items for sale (January 2024), and Beatles music (April 2023, June 2024); the counter looks out on Kumano Shrine (January 2024, January 2026, November 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Freshly baked waffles.

anecdotes.text: A June 2024 diner on a hot Sunday ordered a hot gratin set to warm up from the air conditioning, and was thanked with a cheerful “ookini” on leaving.

A January 2026 visitor, long curious after seeing people lingering over tea in the window, came for waffles and fell for the Cafe Maria Theresa, named after Empress Maria Theresa, said to have liked liqueur in coffee.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: Instagram (@tender_coffee、表示名 Tender Coffee Wonder Waffle): 京都熊野神社前 焼きたてワッフルとコーヒーの店、定休日は火曜と水曜と不定休、営業時間11:00〜18:00。食べログ: テンダーコーヒー ワンダーワッフル、カフェ・喫茶店、左京区聖護院山王町43-2 パレステート日生熊野 2F、月・木・金・土・日 11:00〜18:00、火・水休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、カウンター席、禁煙。口コミ (2021年11月〜2026年11月、英語): 熊野神社の向かいのビルの2階、女性の店主がひとりで切り盛り (2022年)、ワッフルの種類が多い、ドリアやグラタンとハーフワッフルのセット1,300円、モンブランのワッフル750円、くまのぬいぐるみや本、ビートルズの音楽、現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter café; no English evidence found. Cash only.

existence.note: Shop’s Instagram (hours in the bio); Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_kappo_tb26045363_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. The menu has fried horse mackerel, an eel cutlet, a croquette, spring rolls, a tuna sandwich and pasta, and dishes with Saikyo miso and soy-based teriyaki (Tabelog menu, October 2026); no gluten information.
kyoto_kappo_tb26045363_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-centred kaiseki menu with dashi tamagoyaki, and the lunch set comes with red miso soup (Tabelog menu; November 2026 review). Grilled vegetables and sesame tofu are on the menu, but nothing is described as vegan.
kyoto_kappo_tb26045363_sanjo.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun 11:30–13:30 (last seating and L.O. 13:00) and 17:30–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); Thu, public holidays and the days before and after them 17:30–22:30 only; closed Wednesdays (Tabelog, official information). Lunch began in October 2026, four months after opening (November 2026 review). Reservations taken; guests of middle-school age and older only (Tabelog). Courses (tax included): ¥8,000 and ¥10,000, ten dishes each, 2–14 people; a ¥7,000 plan for one group a day in the private room upstairs, eight dishes with 120 minutes of self-serve drinks, 4–10 people (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and iD; no QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: 14 at the counter and a private room for six; private use up to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking, with a smoking spot in the courtyard for one person at a time (Tabelog). On Sanjo-dori west of Aburanokoji, 8 min walk from Nijojo-mae Stn, 472 m (Tabelog). Opened 19 July 2026 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kappo_tb26045363_sanjo.notes: [Kaiseki · Sanjo] A new townhouse restaurant on Sanjo near Aburanokoji (July 2026): an L-shaped counter in front of the charcoal grill and a courtyard at the back, with ¥8,000–10,000 courses or à la carte mixing Kyoto cooking with Chinese and Italian dishes at night, and a ¥2,800 grilled-fish lunch with obanzai and refills of clay-pot rice. Closed Wednesdays.

chef_bio.background: Opened 19 July 2026 (Tabelog). The shop's own Tabelog text describes kaiseki that keeps its tradition while taking in new elements, with Italian and Chinese flavours alongside Japanese cooking. A July 2026 reviewer wrote that the chef trained at a well-known Kyoto restaurant and that the name stands for the idea of constant change.
chef_bio.philosophy: The shop's Tabelog text: kaiseki that evolves by taking in new things while keeping its essence and tradition, without formality.
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled fish and meat; small hot pots of soft-shelled turtle or shark fin; the grilled-fish lunch.

anecdotes.text: A November 2026 couple came in off the Sanjo shopping street after seeing the lunch menu outside; watching the big salmon grilled over charcoal at the counter, the two swapped pieces of salmon and yellowtail, and the staff showed them the private room off the courtyard.

An October 2026 first-timer praised the room, the food and the friendly staff, called the ¥2,800 lunch with unlimited clay-pot rice a great deal, and liked the look of the Japanese–Western dinner menu.
A November 2026 diner liked the sesame tofu among the obanzai and the tender, crisp-skinned grilled fish.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗の公式情報): 富易流行、日本料理・創作料理・海鮮、中京区三条通油小路西入ル橋東詰町27、二条城前駅から徒歩8分 (472m)、月火金土日 11:30〜13:30 (L.O. 13:00)・17:30〜22:30 (L.O. 22:00)、木曜と祝日・祝前日・祝後日は夜のみ、水曜休み、予約可、中学生以上、コース8,000円と10,000円 (10品)、2階の個室の飲み放題つきプラン7,000円、カード・iD 可、20席 (カウンター14席、6名の個室)、中庭に喫煙所、2026年7月19日オープン。京町家の割烹、和食にイタリアンと中華の要素、炭火焼き、季節の日本酒。口コミ (2026年7月〜11月、英語): 京都の名店で修業した料理人、昼の定食2,800円 (おばんざい3品、ぶり・サーモン・さばの炭火焼き、土鍋ごはんのおかわり自由、赤だし)、昼の営業は10月から、L字のカウンター、中庭と個室。

cultural_comfort.note: Courses bookable on Tabelog; phone service may be Japanese only (Tabelog). Friendly staff (October 2026 review).

existence.note: Tabelog official listing (menu updated 19 October 2026); reviews dated July–November 2026.

kyoto_sakura_tb26025197_kiyomizu.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a menu of wheat udon, soba, tempura, katsu-don and curry (Tabelog menu, 2017); no gluten information.
kyoto_sakura_tb26025197_kiyomizu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: udon and soba in dashi broth, rice bowls with egg, chicken, crab, eel or pork; the yuba rice bowl contains chicken (January 2026 review).
kyoto_sakura_tb26025197_kiyomizu.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–17:00, closing days not fixed (Tabelog, official information); the same listing carries an older notice of shortened hours, 11:00–16:00 (L.O. 15:30), during the COVID-19 period. No reservations (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, AMEX); no e-money (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, original text なし). 46 seats: a shared counter of six, six tables for four and four tatami rooms for four (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Children and babies welcome (Tabelog). Upstairs from the 桜士堂 (OSHIDO) souvenir and accessories shop on the Kiyomizu-dera approach, with window seats looking down on the street (Tabelog; May 2022 and December 2024 reviews); 8 min from the Kiyomizu-michi bus stop, 18 min walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_sakura_tb26025197_kiyomizu.notes: [Udon & soba · Kiyomizu-zaka] A big upstairs dining room above a souvenir shop on the way to Kiyomizu-dera: kitsune udon, nishin soba, yuba rice bowls and katsu-don, with window seats over the crowds on the approach. Quick, plain and around ¥1,000–2,000; one reviewer found the udon very poor, others liked the yuba bowl and herring soba.

chef_bio.background: The dining room is the second floor of 京みやげ 桜士堂, a Kyoto souvenir and traditional-accessories shop founded in 1887 (Meiji 20) according to its own site (oshido.com); Tabelog lists the shop below and the dining room above.
chef_bio.specialty: Yuba rice bowl; nishin soba; kitsune udon.

anecdotes.text: Coming back from a New Year shrine visit to Kiyomizu in January 2026, a diner was seated at once (groups were waiting minutes later), chose the yuba bowl over katsu-don, and was told it would take about 15 minutes; it arrived together with a companion's order.
A February 2026 visitor with no expectations found the herring in the nishin soba carefully deboned and the broth rich, though the soba itself was average.
In April 2026 the room was nearly empty; the staff had to be called over, but the cook kept glancing across, which made it easier for a shy diner.
An October 2024 group who all ordered udon called it the least tasty udon the reviewer had ever eaten, with no chewiness at all.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗の公式情報): お食事処 さくら、定食・カフェ・日本料理、東山区清水1-276 桜士堂 2F、清水五条駅から徒歩18分、バス停「清水道」から8分、毎日 10:00〜17:00、不定休 (新型コロナの時期は11:00〜16:00)、予約不可、カード可、サービス料なし、46席 (相席のカウンター6席、テーブル、座敷)、禁煙、子ども可。1階は京みやげと和装小物の桜士堂、2階が食事処。メニュー (2017年4月更新): うどん、そば、和風の中華そば、丼物、カレー。桜士堂の公式サイト: 創業明治20年 (1887年)、各種うどん・そば・丼物からカレーライスまで、京ゆば丼、抹茶ガトーショコラ。口コミ (2015〜2026年、英語): 窓ぎわの席から参道を見下ろす、ゆば丼、にしんそば、きつねうどん、山かけうどん、抹茶ビール。

cultural_comfort.note: A busy sightseeing stop on the Kiyomizu approach with a menu posted outside (January 2026 review); the server was very nice (May 2026 review).

existence.note: Tabelog official listing; reviews dated through May 2026; the owner's site (oshido.com) describes the dining room.

kyoto_kameya_iori_nijo.gf_detail: Ask. Dry sweets for the tea ceremony — sugar candy, pressed sugar sweets and senbei wafers (2013–2023 reviews); no ingredient or gluten information.
kyoto_kameya_iori_nijo.vegan_detail: Ask. Sugar candy and pressed sugar sweets (2015–2023 reviews); no ingredient information.
kyoto_kameya_iori_nijo.hours_raw: Takeaway only, by reservation only: 9:00–16:00, closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Order by phone in advance (a January 2018 reviewer called about ten days ahead); the reviewer of March 2023 had heard that the shop asks about the size of the tea gathering, the host's intentions, the utensils and the matcha. The basic order is a set of two or three kinds of dry sweets for a tea gathering, usually from about ten portions, five at the least (Tabelog). A January 2018 regular warned that first-time visitors are not welcomed; first-time buyers in January 2018 and March 2023 ordered by phone and were served. No cards (Tabelog). No branches, no delivery and no samples (2018 and 2023 reviews). On Nijo-dori east of Shinmachi, a black-and-white noren at the door; 376 m from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog; January 2018 review). Founded in the early 1600s (Waraku, July 2014 issue); family succession: a July 2013 reviewer calls it family-run, and a January 2019 reviewer spoke to the previous owner.
kyoto_kameya_iori_nijo.notes: [Tea sweets · Nijo] A Kyoto confectioner making only dry sweets for the tea ceremony since the early 1600s: delicate sugar candy, pressed sugar sweets and senbei, made to order for each gathering. Phone ahead (usually ten portions or more), collect at the townhouse on Nijo; no shop window, no branches, no samples. Takeaway only.

chef_bio.background: Founded in the early 1600s; by oral tradition the name 伊織 was granted when the shop offered a sweet called 「木の葉」 to the third shogun, Tokugawa Iemitsu; it has made nothing but dry sweets for tea gatherings for 400 years; the owner is 山田和市 (Waraku, July 2014 issue, reprinted 21 August 2019). A March 2023 reviewer adds that the founding year is not known because records were lost to fires and upheavals. A July 2013 reviewer calls it a family-run business keeping traditional methods; a January 2019 reviewer, who first came with a grandmother, recalled the previous owner explaining that some sweets harden quickly, so the work must be fast and exact.
chef_bio.philosophy: Only sweets for tea, each made to suit the season and the theme of the gathering (Waraku; 2013 and 2018 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Sugar candy; pressed sugar sweets; senbei for tea.

anecdotes.text: A January 2018 buyer booked by phone about ten days ahead and, hearing the sweets were for tea with friends, was recommended a pressed sugar sweet and a candy; collected in a calm room of earthen floor and tatami with a charcoal hibachi, scrolls and a paulownia chest, but no showcase.
An Urasenke student in October 2015 wrote that the sugar candy is processed until it is not sticky at all, so it melts at once — the host offers it just before serving thin tea.
In February 2019 a buyer was set aside fox-mask senbei, with eyes drawn on with a hot iron, and a twisted red-and-white candy for the first Uma festival at Fushimi Inari, kept in a paulownia chest.
A March 2023 first-timer, after hesitating for years over the questions the shop asks when booking, finally ordered, bringing matcha from a historic Kyoto tea shop.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 亀屋伊織、和菓子、中京区二条通新町東入ル、烏丸御池駅から376m、9:00〜16:00、不定休 (完全予約制)、カード不可、テイクアウト。茶会用の干菓子の販売が基本で、2〜3種から選び、通常は10人前ほどから、5人前から応じる。和樂 (2014年7月号、2019年8月21日掲載): 創業1600年代初め、茶会に出される干菓子のみをつくり続けて400年、徳川家光公に「木の葉」という菓子を献上して「伊織」の名を賜ったという口伝、主人は山田和市さん、要予約。口コミ (2008〜2025年): 家族で営む (2013年7月)、支店も配送もない、見本なし (2018年、2023年)、有平糖、落雁、煎餅、季節のおまかせ2種10人前2,484円 (2018年1月)、20個のセット5,000円 (2013年7月)、先代の話 (2019年1月)、一見は難しいという声 (2018年1月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Phone orders only, and the shop asks about the tea gathering when booking (March 2023 review); phone service may be Japanese only (Tabelog). One January 2018 reviewer says first-time visitors are not welcomed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (no official information); latest review dated November 2025; Waraku article reprinted August 2019.

kyoto_jikon_hiratate_marutamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Fried white shrimp dusted with shrimp powder and fried eggplant appear in several reviews, and a sukiyaki appeared in January 2025 (2022–25 reviews); no gluten information. The shop asks guests to state allergies when booking (Tabelog).
kyoto_jikon_hiratate_marutamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-centred kappo, and the shop says it cannot change the menu for guests who do not eat fish (Tabelog).
kyoto_jikon_hiratate_marutamachi.hours_raw: Tue–Fri, public holidays and the days before and after them 17:00–22:00; Sat–Sun 15:00–22:00 (food L.O. 21:00); closed Mondays, plus a longer break once a month — ask the shop (Tabelog; Michelin Guide). Reservations taken; state any allergies; no strong perfume (Tabelog). The shop's note for visitors from overseas: guests who cannot communicate in Japanese are served the course only; there are no English-speaking staff; changes other than for allergies may not be possible on the day, and the menu cannot be changed for guests who do not like fish (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 11 seats: 7 at the counter and a semi-private room for 2–4 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; smoking outside (Tabelog). 2 min walk from Exit 5 of Marutamachi Stn, 124 m (Tabelog). Opened 15 April 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_jikon_hiratate_marutamachi.notes: [Kappo · Marutamachi] An eleven-seat kappo by Marutamachi Stn, opened in 2022 by a former head chef of the Pontocho kappo 余志屋別館: seasonal fish in surprising pairings, fried white shrimp, fruit shira-ae and clay-pot rice, à la carte after two opening dishes or as a course. About ¥15,000–20,000; guests who do not speak Japanese get the course only.

chef_bio.background: The owner, 平舘亮祐 (ひらたてりょうすけ, Waraku), trained at Japanese restaurants including the traditional 西陣魚新 and was then head chef of 余志屋別館 in Pontocho (Serai, September 2022); Waraku describes 余志屋 (よしや) 別館 as a kappo known for kamameshi. The owner was 38 in September 2022 (Serai) and 40 at the time of the Waraku article (2023 issue). Serai names 前田真空 as front-of-house. The shop's Tabelog text gives 18 years in Japanese cuisine. Opened 15 April 2022 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: 而今 means living each present moment to the full; ingredients are chosen with care and paired in creative ways, such as a fruit shira-ae (Michelin Guide).
chef_bio.specialty: Ingredient pairings; fried white shrimp with shrimp powder; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: A July 2022 couple booked the counter for a late hour, waited in the semi-private room and were offered the counter when it freed up, but stayed put; when the two could not choose between corn and scallop mixed rice, the shop made both. The review is titled "a welcoming kappo run by a lovely couple".
A June 2024 first-timer at the counter felt neglected: the owner and a female staff member talked only with the regulars on both sides once the dishes were served, and the sake list was short.
An October 2024 group of three spent three hours in the semi-private room, ordering seven dishes à la carte with six glasses of sake recommended along the way, for just over ¥66,000.
A diner who had to dash for the Shinkansen after an August 2024 dinner came back with a friend from Osaka in July 2025 for the hot uzaku.

In September 2022 the dishes were slow enough that the diner gave up on a few orders; there was no draught beer and the semi-private room was cold. By November 2024 the same diner found the service faster but missed the Chinese touches of the earlier visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗の公式情報): 而今 平たて、日本料理、中京区少将井御旅町352-1、丸太町駅5番出口から徒歩2分 (124m)、火〜金・祝日・祝前日・祝後日 17:00〜22:00、土日 15:00〜22:00 (料理L.O. 21:00)、月曜休み、月に一度の連休、予約可、アレルギーは予約時に、香水は控える、日本語での会話が難しい方はコースのみ、英語のできるスタッフはいない、魚が苦手な方への変更は不可、カード可、11席 (カウンター7席、2〜4名の半個室)、禁煙、2022年4月15日オープン。サライ (2022年9月17日、取材・文 中井シノブ): 店主の平舘亮祐さん (38歳)、『西陣魚新』など和食店で修業ののち先斗町『余志屋別館』の料理長、接客担当の前田真空さん、松茸と白ぐじの酒蒸し (2人前) 6000円、「渡り蟹ときくらげ 菊花のジュレ」2800円、秋鯖のきずしとシャインマスカット1800円、日本酒 (1合) 1000円から。和樂 (2024年10月16日、2023年10・11月号より): 而今 平たて (じこん ひらたて)、店主・平舘亮祐 (ひらたてりょうすけ) さん、現在40歳、前職は釜飯で知られる割烹「余志屋 (よしや) 別館」の料理長、看板料理の土鍋ごはん、アラカルトでひとり17,000円前後、コースは7品で16,000円から (2024年9月時点)。ミシュランガイド: 而今とは、今一瞬を懸命に生きる意味。口コミ (2022〜2025年、英語): 最初に季節の2品、あとは好みで注文、白えびの揚げ物、土鍋ごはん、ご夫婦で営むという口コミの題 (2022年7月)、常連とばかり話していたという声 (2024年6月)。

cultural_comfort.note: The shop's own note: guests who cannot communicate in Japanese are served the course only, and there are no English-speaking staff (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog official listing; Michelin Guide listing; reviews dated through July 2025.
